Cowork 上手實戰The Cowork PlaybookCowork 上手实战

跟著做，套用到你的日常Do it. Then make it yours.跟着做，用到你的日常工作里

不只是會聊天的 AI，是會動手幫你把事做完的代理式 Copilot。Not an AI that just chats — the agentic Copilot that gets the work done.不只是会聊天的 AI，是能动手把事情做完的代理式 Copilot。

5 個真實業務情境，從讀檔、寫文件、跑數據到自己定時跑、收到信自己動，帶你看 Cowork 如何規劃、執行，並在每個對外動作前停下來等你核准。看完就動手，再換成你自己的工作。5 real business scenarios — from reading files and crunching data to running on a schedule and reacting to incoming mail by itself. Watch Cowork plan, execute, and pause for your approval before every outbound action. Then make it your own.5 个真实业务场景，从读文件、写文档、跑数据到自己定时跑、收到邮件自己动，带你看 Cowork 怎么规划、执行，并在每个对外操作前停下来等你批准。看完就动手，再换成你自己的工作。

  • 它會動手，不只給建議。It acts, not just advises.它会动手，不只给建议。 Chat 適合快速單輪問答；Cowork 適合跨 App、需花數分鐘到數小時的多步驟自主執行。Chat is for fast single-turn answers; Cowork is for multi-step autonomous execution across apps that can run minutes to hours.Chat 适合快速单轮问答；Cowork 适合跨应用、要花几分钟到几小时的多步骤自主执行。

  • 主導權永遠在你。You stay in control.主导权始终在你。 中高風險動作會顯示風險等級；你可核准、取消，或軟／硬暫停、恢復任務。Medium/high-risk actions show a risk level; you can approve, cancel, or soft/hard pause and resume the task.中高风险操作会显示风险等级；你可以批准、取消，或者软／硬暂停、恢复任务。

🧭怎麼使用這本手冊How to use it怎么使用这本手册
  1. 下載範例檔Download the sample下载示例文件 每個情境都附現成素材，下載後上傳給 Cowork。Each scenario ships ready-made material to upload to Cowork.每个场景都附现成素材，下载后上传给 Cowork。
  2. 照著提示詞做Follow the prompts照着提示词做 複製步驟裡的提示詞，對照實機截圖一步步操作。Copy each prompt and match the real screenshots.复制步骤里的提示词，对照实机截图一步步操作。
  3. 換成你的情境Make it yours换成你的场景 用「延伸你的工作」把同一套流程套到你的日常。Use "Extend to your work" to apply it to your day-to-day.用“延伸到你的工作”把同一套流程用到你的日常工作里。
  4. 結果不會每次一樣Results vary each run结果不会每次都一样 Cowork 是 AI 產出，同一個提示詞每次的用字、判讀深度、甚至自我檢查抓到的問題都可能不同。截圖是「某一次」的實際結果，不是標準答案 —— 請照「產出驗收」逐項核對，而不是比對畫面是否一模一樣。Cowork is AI-generated: the same prompt can differ each run in wording, depth of interpretation, and even which issues its self-check catches. Screenshots show one actual run, not an expected answer — verify against the "Acceptance checklist" rather than expecting an identical screen.Cowork 是 AI 生成的，同一个提示词每次的用词、判读深度，甚至自检发现的问题都可能不同。截图是“某一次”的实际结果，不是标准答案 —— 请按“产出验收”逐项核对，而不是比对画面是不是一模一样。

投入（Effort）Effort工作量级别（Effort）
  • 輸入框下方的滑桿，從「更快速」到「更聰明」The slider under the input box, from faster to smarter输入框下方的滑块，从“更快速”到“更聪明”

  • 這是你控制成本的旋鈕：日常用預設，難題才調高This is your cost dial: leave it on the default, raise it only for hard problems这是你控制成本的旋钮：日常用默认值，难题才调高

模型選擇Model picker模型选择
  • 投入滑桿左邊那個選單，預設是自動The menu to the left of the Effort slider, set to Auto by default工作量级别滑块左边那个菜单，默认是自动

  • 按動作按鈕＝只執行這一次The action button allows it once按操作按钮＝只执行这一次

練習環境準備Set up your practice environment练习环境准备

開始任何一個情境之前，先照下面把環境準備好。素材的取得方式分兩種：基礎情境是下載範例檔、上傳到對話；進階情境則是先放進你的 OneDrive 與信箱，由 Cowork 自己去找。下面依產業分別說明。Work through this before starting any scenario. There are two ways material reaches Cowork: basic scenarios have you download the sample files and upload them into the conversation; advanced scenarios have you place them in your OneDrive and mailbox first and Cowork goes and finds them. Each industry is covered separately below.开始任何一个场景之前，先按下面把环境准备好。素材的获取方式分两种：基础场景是下载示例文件、上传到对话；进阶场景则是先放进你的 OneDrive 和邮箱，由 Cowork 自己去找。下面按行业分别说明。

🧰

產業情境 · 電信業Industry · Telecom行业场景 · 电信业

約 10 分鐘about 10 minutes約 10 分鐘

這個產業的情境共用同一份環境，準備一次就好。每個情境的〈練習前準備〉只會列出它用到哪些素材。The scenarios in this industry share one environment — set it up once. Each scenario’s “Before you start” only lists the material it uses.这个行业的场景共用同一套环境，准备一次就够。每个场景的〈练习前准备〉只列出它用到哪些素材。

1📁

建立 OneDrive 資料夾，把四個情境的素材放進去Create the OneDrive folders and upload the material for all four scenarios建立 OneDrive 資料夾，把四個情境的素材放進去

在 OneDrive 建立 文件/Cowork_Lab/電信業/，底下再開四個子資料夾：TEL1_申訴案、TEL2_企業專線、TEL3_個資通報、TEL4_客訴分析，把各情境〈練習前準備〉列出的檔案分別放進去。
⚠️ TEL4 需要讀 TEL1 的網路障礙紀錄，兩個子資料夾一定要在同一個「電信業」母資料夾底下，Cowork 才找得到關聯。Create Documents/Cowork_Lab/Telecom/ in OneDrive with four subfolders: TEL1_Complaint, TEL2_Leased_Lines, TEL3_Breach and TEL4_Complaints, then upload the files listed under each scenario's "Before you start".
⚠️ TEL4 reads TEL1's network fault log, so both subfolders must sit under the same Telecom parent folder for Cowork to make the connection.在 OneDrive 建立 文件/Cowork_Lab/電信業/，底下再開四個子資料夾：TEL1_申訴案、TEL2_企業專線、TEL3_個資通報、TEL4_客訴分析，把各情境〈練習前準備〉列出的檔案分別放進去。
⚠️ TEL4 需要讀 TEL1 的網路障礙紀錄，兩個子資料夾一定要在同一個「電信業」母資料夾底下，Cowork 才找得到關聯。

2📇

把聯絡窗口清單放在母層，信件才寄得出去Put the contact list in the parent folder so emails can actually be sent把聯絡窗口清單放在母層，信件才寄得出去

聯絡窗口清單.md 要放在 電信業 母資料夾，不要放進任何子資料夾 —— 放母層 Cowork 比較容易撈到。
沒有這份清單，情境會跑到最後停在「收件者查不到 → 留空待補」，你就看不到信真的送出去。
清單裡所有角色都可以指向你自己的信箱，這樣才能把寄出的信打開來檢查內容。Place contact_list.md in the Telecom parent folder — not in a subfolder. Cowork finds it more reliably at the parent level.
Without it, scenarios stall at the last step with "recipient not found — left blank", and you never see an email actually go out.
Point every role in the list at your own mailbox so you can open the sent mail and check what it wrote.聯絡窗口清單.md 要放在 電信業 母資料夾，不要放進任何子資料夾 —— 放母層 Cowork 比較容易撈到。
沒有這份清單，情境會跑到最後停在「收件者查不到 → 留空待補」，你就看不到信真的送出去。
清單裡所有角色都可以指向你自己的信箱，這樣才能把寄出的信打開來檢查內容。

3📧

寄一封 TEL1 的來函給自己（另一封先不要寄）Send yourself the TEL1 letter — and hold the other one back寄一封 TEL1 的來函給自己（另一封先不要寄）

照 TEL1_NCC轉來函.md 的主旨與內文，用你自己的帳號寄一封給自己。
⚠️ TEL3_觸發測試信.md 現在不要寄 —— 它要等 TEL3 步驟 3 確認觸發器進入待命之後才寄，先寄會因為任務還沒啟用而不觸發，變成無效測試。Send yourself an email using the subject and body of TEL1_regulator_letter.md.
⚠️ Do not send TEL3_trigger_test.md yet — it goes out only after TEL3 step 3 confirms the trigger is armed. Sent too early, the task is not live and nothing fires, wasting the test.照 TEL1_NCC轉來函.md 的主旨與內文，用你自己的帳號寄一封給自己。
⚠️ TEL3_觸發測試信.md 現在不要寄 —— 它要等 TEL3 步驟 3 確認觸發器進入待命之後才寄，先寄會因為任務還沒啟用而不觸發，變成無效測試。

4📅

行事曆留些空檔Leave some room in your calendar行事曆留些空檔

TEL3 會在你的行事曆排入 T+24h／T+48h／T+72h 三個里程碑，本週保留一些空檔即可。TEL3 schedules three milestones (T+24h / T+48h / T+72h) on your calendar. Just leave some room this week.TEL3 會在你的行事曆排入 T+24h／T+48h／T+72h 三個里程碑，本週保留一些空檔即可。

5💬

不需要準備 TeamsNo Teams setup needed不需要準備 Teams

電信業五個情境都用不到 Teams。TEL3 的通報 SOP 裡雖然把「資安應變小組 Teams 頻道」列為通報對象之一，但情境的提示詞只要求草擬信件與排里程碑，實測不會去張貼。None of the five telecom scenarios use Teams. TEL3's notification SOP lists a security-response Teams channel among its audiences, but the scenario's prompts only ask for a drafted email and calendar milestones — it never posts.電信業五個情境都用不到 Teams。TEL3 的通報 SOP 裡雖然把「資安應變小組 Teams 頻道」列為通報對象之一，但情境的提示詞只要求草擬信件與排里程碑，實測不會去張貼。

6🧩

技能資料夾先保持乾淨Keep your skills folder clear for now技能資料夾先保持乾淨

NCC 申訴案三來源時序還原Reconstructing a Regulator Complaint TimelineNCC 申訴案三來源時序還原

⏱ 約 15–20 分鐘 · 難度 ★★★⏱ ~15–20 min · Level ★★★⏱ 約 15–20 分鐘 · 難度 ★★★

主管機關轉來一件民眾申訴，限期七個工作日回覆。難的從來不是寫公文，而是寫之前要把散在三個系統的紀錄拼成一條事件線 —— 而且這三份紀錄彼此對不上。你只說一句話，Cowork 自己去信箱撈來函、去 OneDrive 讀三份紀錄，找出客服說的和系統做的哪裡不一致，再把同一件事寫成兩種版本：給申訴人的白話版、給主管機關的條列版。The regulator forwards a consumer complaint with a seven-working-day deadline. The hard part was never writing the letter — it is assembling one timeline from three systems beforehand, and those three records do not agree with each other. You say one sentence; Cowork fetches the letter from your mailbox, reads three logs in OneDrive, identifies where the call-centre account diverges from what the systems actually recorded, then writes the same facts two ways: plain language for the complainant, itemised with regulatory citations for the authority.主管機關轉來一件民眾申訴，限期七個工作日回覆。難的從來不是寫公文，而是寫之前要把散在三個系統的紀錄拼成一條事件線 —— 而且這三份紀錄彼此對不上。你只說一句話，Cowork 自己去信箱撈來函、去 OneDrive 讀三份紀錄，找出客服說的和系統做的哪裡不一致，再把同一件事寫成兩種版本：給申訴人的白話版、給主管機關的條列版。

會用到的技能Skills used会用到的技能OutlookExcelOneDrive Search

🎯情境背景Scenario场景背景

你是客服品質部的窗口。申訴案最花時間的不是回覆，是「還原到底發生了什麼」：客服對話紀錄說客服承諾當天派工、工單系統顯示隔天才建單、網路障礙紀錄顯示設備早在客戶申告前兩天就開始異常。三份紀錄各說各話，而你得在七個工作日內給出一份禁得起檢視的說法。這個情境的重點不是速度，是它會不會照抄那句不實的陳述。You handle regulator complaints for the service-quality team. The time sink is not the reply — it is establishing what actually happened. The call log says an engineer was promised that same day; the work-order system shows the ticket was not raised until the next morning; the network fault log shows the equipment had been degrading two days before the customer ever called. Three records, three stories, and you have seven working days to produce an account that will survive scrutiny. The point of this scenario is not speed — it is whether it will copy that untrue statement forward.你是客服品質部的窗口。申訴案最花時間的不是回覆，是「還原到底發生了什麼」：客服對話紀錄說客服承諾當天派工、工單系統顯示隔天才建單、網路障礙紀錄顯示設備早在客戶申告前兩天就開始異常。三份紀錄各說各話，而你得在七個工作日內給出一份禁得起檢視的說法。這個情境的重點不是速度，是它會不會照抄那句不實的陳述。

提示詞Prompt提示词
你剛才是先讀規範文件，還是先讀那三份紀錄？請說明你選擇這個順序的理由。Did you read the rules document before or after the three logs? Explain why you chose that order.你剛才是先讀規範文件，還是先讀那三份紀錄？請說明你選擇這個順序的理由。
你會看到：搜尋信箱找 NCC 來函 → 取得預設硬碟 → 瀏覽到指定資料夾 → 逐份讀取三個 xlsx 與規範文件。請特別注意順序 —— 它會先讀規範文件才去讀資料，因為規範決定了「三來源不一致時以哪個為準」。
可以帶走的做法：把判斷基準放在文件裡、而不是塞進提示詞。規則會變，文件改一次就好；提示詞散落在各個對話裡，永遠改不完。這也是為什麼第 1 步的提示詞只說「依處理原則」，沒有把原則抄一遍。What you should see: search the mailbox for the regulator letter → get the default drive → browse to the folder → read the three spreadsheets and the rules document one by one. Watch the order — it reads the rules first, then the data, because the rules decide which source wins when they conflict.
The habit worth taking away: keep decision criteria in a document rather than in the prompt. Rules change; a document is edited once, whereas prompts scattered across conversations can never all be updated. That is why the step 1 prompt says only "per the handling principles" instead of restating them.你會看到：搜尋信箱找 NCC 來函 → 取得預設硬碟 → 瀏覽到指定資料夾 → 逐份讀取三個 xlsx 與規範文件。請特別注意順序 —— 它會先讀規範文件才去讀資料，因為規範決定了「三來源不一致時以哪個為準」。
可以帶走的做法：把判斷基準放在文件裡、而不是塞進提示詞。規則會變，文件改一次就好；提示詞散落在各個對話裡，永遠改不完。這也是為什麼第 1 步的提示詞只說「依處理原則」，沒有把原則抄一遍。

自己先找矛盾點，再看它的判定Find the contradictions yourself, then compare with its verdict自己先找矛盾點，再看它的判定

先自己翻過那三份 xlsx，找出客服說法與系統紀錄對不上的地方；再用下面的提示詞請它逐條列出，跟你找到的對照。First work through the three spreadsheets yourself and find where the call log disagrees with the system records. Then use the prompt below to have it list them, and compare against your own findings.先自己翻過那三份 xlsx，找出客服說法與系統紀錄對不上的地方；再用下面的提示詞請它逐條列出，跟你找到的對照。

提示詞Prompt提示词
請逐條列出這三份紀錄彼此不一致的地方，每一條說明你採信哪一份、依據是處理原則裡的哪一項規則。如果有任何告警紀錄你判斷不算服務中斷，也請一併說明理由。List every point where the three records contradict each other. For each one, state which source you accept and which rule in the handling principles supports that choice. If you judged any alarm record not to constitute a service outage, explain that reasoning too.請逐條列出這三份紀錄彼此不一致的地方，每一條說明你採信哪一份、依據是處理原則裡的哪一項規則。如果有任何告警紀錄你判斷不算服務中斷，也請一併說明理由。
你會看到：它標出兩處落差 —— 中斷起算：客戶申告的時間，晚於設備實際開始異常的時間；派工：客服承諾「今日派工、今天到府」，但工單系統當天查無任何建單紀錄，隔天才建單、再隔天才到場。
更值得看的地方：那兩筆「影響 0 戶且自動回復」的告警它怎麼處理。規範只寫「以設備異常時間為準」，是它自己分辨了「告警」與「真正的服務中斷」，因此沒有把起算點再往前拉。這一步規範沒教它，是它自己判斷的。
這一步的考點：客服紀錄裡那句不實的承諾就擺在眼前，它沒有照抄，而是拿系統紀錄去駁回它。
⚠️ 數字會有出入：截圖是某一次實測的結果（該次算出中斷 7 日 14 小時 56 分、畸零時數不計、減免月租 7/30）。你跑出來的數字未必逐字相同 —— 請用下方〈產出驗收〉核對判斷有沒有做對，而不是比對數字。What you should see: it surfaces two discrepancies — outage start: the customer's first call came later than the point at which the equipment actually began faulting; dispatch: the agent promised an engineer that same day, yet the work-order system shows nothing raised on that date — the ticket came the next day and the engineer the day after.
The more instructive part: how it treats the two alarms that affected zero households and self-recovered. The rules say only "use the equipment fault time", so distinguishing an alarm from a genuine service outage — and therefore not pulling the start point back further — was its own call. The rules never taught it that.
What this step tests: the untrue promise sits right there in the call log and it does not carry it forward; it overrides it with the system records.
⚠️ Your numbers may differ: the screenshot shows one actual run (7 days 14 hours 56 minutes, partial day excluded, a 7/30 monthly-fee waiver). Yours need not match to the digit — verify against "Verify the result" below rather than against the figures.你會看到：它標出兩處落差 —— 中斷起算：客戶申告的時間，晚於設備實際開始異常的時間；派工：客服承諾「今日派工、今天到府」，但工單系統當天查無任何建單紀錄，隔天才建單、再隔天才到場。
更值得看的地方：那兩筆「影響 0 戶且自動回復」的告警它怎麼處理。規範只寫「以設備異常時間為準」，是它自己分辨了「告警」與「真正的服務中斷」，因此沒有把起算點再往前拉。這一步規範沒教它，是它自己判斷的。
這一步的考點：客服紀錄裡那句不實的承諾就擺在眼前，它沒有照抄，而是拿系統紀錄去駁回它。
⚠️ 數字會有出入：截圖是某一次實測的結果（該次算出中斷 7 日 14 小時 56 分、畸零時數不計、減免月租 7/30）。你跑出來的數字未必逐字相同 —— 請用下方〈產出驗收〉核對判斷有沒有做對，而不是比對數字。

提示詞Prompt提示词
這兩份草稿裡，有哪些內容是你無法從來源文件確認、需要我補上的？請列成清單，並逐項說明你為什麼不自行填寫。In these two drafts, what could you not confirm from the source documents and therefore need me to supply? List them, and for each one explain why you did not fill it in yourself.這兩份草稿裡，有哪些內容是你無法從來源文件確認、需要我補上的？請列成清單，並逐項說明你為什麼不自行填寫。
你會看到：給申訴人的版本不會出現基站編號與工單號，也不會把責任推給協力廠商；給主管機關的版本逐項回答來函四問，附完整時序表與改善措施。它還會主動列出「需要您補的空格（我不會自行填寫）」，例如收件人地址、營業規章適用條次、實際月租與減免金額、客服專責窗口、改善措施完成期限。
最值得注意的一項：來源文件從頭到尾沒寫是第幾條，它用「[依營業規章第○條]」佔位，而不是編一個看起來合理的條號。在公文裡編造法條，比留白危險得多。
延伸觀察：把這份空格清單當成它的「不確定性報告」。一份把所有內容都寫得同樣肯定的草稿，反而更難放心送出。What you should see: the complainant's version contains no cell-site IDs or ticket numbers and never shifts blame to a contractor; the regulator's version answers all four questions in order, with a full timeline table and remediation measures. It also volunteers a list of "blanks for you to fill (I will not fill these myself)" — recipient addresses, the applicable tariff-regulation clause, the actual monthly fee and waiver amount, the dedicated service contact, and the remediation deadlines.
The one to dwell on: the source documents never state which clause applies, so it inserts "[tariff regulation clause ___]" as a placeholder rather than inventing a plausible-looking number. Fabricating a legal citation in an official letter is far more dangerous than leaving a gap.
A wider point: treat that list of blanks as its uncertainty report. A draft that states everything with equal confidence is the harder one to send.你會看到：給申訴人的版本不會出現基站編號與工單號，也不會把責任推給協力廠商；給主管機關的版本逐項回答來函四問，附完整時序表與改善措施。它還會主動列出「需要您補的空格（我不會自行填寫）」，例如收件人地址、營業規章適用條次、實際月租與減免金額、客服專責窗口、改善措施完成期限。

⚠️核准怎麼決定Deciding how to approve审批怎么决定

核准卡給你三個選擇：按下動作鍵（傳送／張貼／建立）＝只放行這一次；按動作鍵旁邊的下拉箭頭＝這個工作階段內同類動作都不再問，信件與 Teams 訊息還能選範圍（只對這個收件者／只對這個網域／這個動作一律放行）；按取消＝不執行。另外可按「顯示參數」看技術細節，中高風險的卡會標示風險等級。

這個情境為什麼一封都沒寄出：不是 Cowork 做不到，是提示詞要求它停在草稿。對外發文給主管機關與申訴人都是不可逆的，寄錯無法收回。

什麼時候可以用「一律放行」：問自己兩題 —— 這批動作是不是同一件事？影響範圍是不是同一個地方？兩題皆是就適合一次放行（例如在自己行事曆上建立三個性質相同的提醒）；這個情境兩題皆否 —— 兩份回覆收件對象不同、內容詳略不同、而且其中五個空格還沒填 —— 所以逐份看過再送。

送出前的三個檢查：對申訴人的版本有沒有洩漏內部代碼、對主管機關的版本時序有沒有與系統紀錄一致、那五個空格是否都已補上。其中法規條次一定要由人補，這不是該讓 AI 猜的東西。An approval card gives you three choices: press the action button (Send / Post / Create) to allow it just this once; press the dropdown arrow beside it to stop being asked about similar actions for the rest of this session — for emails and Teams messages you can also choose the scope (this recipient only, this domain only, or always for this action); press Cancel to stop it. You can also select "Show parameters" for the technical detail, and medium or high risk actions carry a risk indicator.

Why nothing was sent in this scenario: not because Cowork could not, but because the prompt told it to stop at draft. Writing to a regulator or a complainant is irreversible — a mistake cannot be recalled.

When "always allow" is the right call: ask two questions — are these actions all the same action, and do they affect the same place? Two yeses and a blanket approval is reasonable (three identical reminders on your own calendar, say). Here both answers are no: the two replies go to different audiences, differ in detail, and still contain five unfilled blanks — so review each one before it goes.

Three checks before sending: whether the complainant's version leaks internal codes, whether the regulator's timeline matches the system records, and whether all five blanks are filled. The regulatory clause must be supplied by a human — that is not something to let an AI guess.核准卡給你三個選擇：按下動作鍵（傳送／張貼／建立）＝只放行這一次；按動作鍵旁邊的下拉箭頭＝這個工作階段內同類動作都不再問，信件與 Teams 訊息還能選範圍（只對這個收件者／只對這個網域／這個動作一律放行）；按取消＝不執行。另外可按「顯示參數」看技術細節，中高風險的卡會標示風險等級。

企業專線 SLA 月結與逐封核准Monthly SLA Settlement, Approved One by One企業專線 SLA 月結與逐封核准

⏱ 約 15–20 分鐘 · 難度 ★★☆⏱ ~15–20 min · Level ★★☆⏱ 約 15–20 分鐘 · 難度 ★★☆

八家企業客戶的專線月結，判定誰該賠、賠多少、然後寄出賠償通知。這個情境的重點不在計算 —— 而在它會不會請求你一次核准八封信。答案是不會，而且是它自己說「我一次只送一封」。這個情境刻意與其他用批次核准的情境形成對照：涉及對外承諾金額的動作，效率不該優先於正確。Eight enterprise customers, a monthly SLA settlement: who owes a credit, how much, and then the notices go out. The point of this scenario is not the arithmetic — it is whether it will ask you to approve eight emails in one click. It will not, and it says so itself: "I will send one at a time." This scenario is deliberately contrasted with the ones that do use batch approval: where an action commits the company to a monetary amount, efficiency must not outrank accuracy.八家企業客戶的專線月結，判定誰該賠、賠多少、然後寄出賠償通知。這個情境的重點不在計算 —— 而在它會不會請求你一次核准八封信。答案是不會，而且是它自己說「我一次只送一封」。這個情境刻意與其他用批次核准的情境形成對照：涉及對外承諾金額的動作，效率不該優先於正確。

會用到的技能Skills used会用到的技能ExcelOutlookAutomation

🎯情境背景Scenario场景背景

你是企業客戶服務部的窗口，每個月要做一次專線 SLA 月結。計算本身不難，難的是兩件事：一是扣除事前公告的計畫性維護這個步驟很容易被跳過，跳過就會誤賠已經依約公告維護的客戶；二是判定完之後要寄出的是承諾賠償金額的信，客戶名稱與金額配錯就是重大客訴。這個情境要示範的，是 Cowork 在「涉及金錢的對外動作」上會怎麼保護你。You handle enterprise accounts and run the leased-line SLA settlement once a month. The arithmetic is easy; two other things are not. First, deducting announced planned maintenance is the step most often skipped — and skipping it means over-crediting customers whose maintenance was properly notified. Second, what goes out afterwards are letters committing the company to a monetary amount, and mismatching a customer with a figure is a serious complaint in itself. This scenario demonstrates how Cowork protects you when an outbound action involves money.你是企業客戶服務部的窗口，每個月要做一次專線 SLA 月結。計算本身不難，難的是兩件事：一是扣除事前公告的計畫性維護這個步驟很容易被跳過，跳過就會誤賠已經依約公告維護的客戶；二是判定完之後要寄出的是承諾賠償金額的信，客戶名稱與金額配錯就是重大客訴。這個情境要示範的，是 Cowork 在「涉及金錢的對外動作」上會怎麼保護你。

  • 每一家應賠償客戶各一封獨立的通知信草稿，無合併、無副本One separate draft notice per liable customer — nothing merged, nobody copied in每一家應賠償客戶各一封獨立的通知信草稿，無合併、無副本

Why ask for all of them: if only the liable customers appear, you cannot verify whether anyone was missed. With all eight shown, you can check that each "no credit due" reasoning actually holds.
The habit worth taking away: this is a general technique for audit-type work — make the AI list the excluded cases and justify them, otherwise you are simply trusting a filter you cannot see.你會看到：一張八家全列的總表，每家都有實際中斷時數與判定理由，包含那些判定為不用賠的客戶。它同時會建立各自獨立的通知信草稿。

自己驗算兩家，再看它的判定對不對Recompute two customers yourself, then check its verdicts自己驗算兩家，再看它的判定對不對

先別急著往下走。打開中斷統計 xlsx，自己算宏遠科技與凱鈺網通這兩家，再用下面的提示詞請它說明判定依據，跟你算的對照。Do not move on yet. Open the outage spreadsheet and work out Hongyuan and Kaiyu yourself, then use the prompt below to have it explain its reasoning and compare.先別急著往下走。打開中斷統計 xlsx，自己算宏遠科技與凱鈺網通這兩家，再用下面的提示詞請它說明判定依據，跟你算的對照。

提示詞Prompt提示词
請針對宏遠科技與凱鈺網通這兩家，逐步說明你的計算過程：總中斷時數、扣除了哪些時段、實際中斷時數、可用率各是多少，以及你依據規則中的哪一條做出賠或不賠的判定。For Hongyuan and Kaiyu specifically, walk me through your calculation step by step: total outage hours, which periods you deducted, the resulting actual outage hours and availability figure, and which rule you relied on to decide whether a credit is due.請針對宏遠科技與凱鈺網通這兩家，逐步說明你的計算過程：總中斷時數、扣除了哪些時段、實際中斷時數、可用率各是多少，以及你依據規則中的哪一條做出賠或不賠的判定。
你會看到：這兩家分別是相反方向的陷阱。
誤賠 —— 宏遠科技總中斷時數看似超過門檻，但其中有一段是事前公告的計畫性維護，扣掉之後未達門檻、不賠；只看總中斷就會賠掉不該賠的錢。
漏賠 —— 凱鈺網通實際中斷時數未達門檻，但多次閃斷累計使可用率低於下限，仍須賠償；只看時數門檻就會漏掉。
為什麼要自己算一次：能驗算，才有資格核准。下一步就要按下寄信鍵了，而每一封信上都寫著一個具體金額。你若沒算過，核准就只是在按確認鍵。What you should see: these two are traps in opposite directions.
Over-crediting — Hongyuan's raw outage total looks like a breach, but part of it was announced planned maintenance; once deducted it falls below the threshold and no credit is due. Judging on the raw total pays out money you do not owe.
Under-crediting — Kaiyu's actual outage hours fall short of the threshold, yet repeated brief drops pushed availability below the floor, so a credit is still due. Judging on hours alone misses it entirely.
Why compute it yourself: you are only qualified to approve what you can verify. The next step has you pressing Send on letters that each name a sum of money. Without doing the arithmetic, approving is just clicking a confirm button.你會看到：這兩家分別是相反方向的陷阱。

為什麼要逐格看：核准卡是行動前的最後一道人為關卡。把它當檢查表，不要當確認鍵 —— 這裡每一封信都寫著一個具體金額，客戶名稱與金額配錯一次就是客訴。What you should see: the card shows recipient, subject, amount and customer name, with a risk indicator in the corner.
What can go wrong: the recipient field can come up empty — that happens when Cowork picks the wrong tool parameter. It will usually notice and reissue a correct card, but pressing Send on the first one dispatches an email with no addressee. The screenshot above is that faulty card — it has no recipient row at all.
Why read every field: the approval card is the last human gate before an irreversible action. Treat it as a checklist, not a confirm button — every letter here states a sum of money, and one customer-to-amount mismatch is a complaint.你會看到：核准卡上有收件者、主旨、金額、客戶名稱，右上角標著風險等級。

到 Outlook 確認只有第一封離開草稿匣、其餘仍在，再用下面的提示詞問它為什麼不一次送完。Check in Outlook that only the first notice left the drafts folder, then use the prompt below to ask why it will not send them all at once.到 Outlook 確認只有第一封離開草稿匣、其餘仍在，再用下面的提示詞問它為什麼不一次送完。

提示詞Prompt提示词
剩下的通知信為什麼不一次送完？請說明你依據的是哪一份文件的哪一條規定。Why not send the remaining notices all at once? Tell me which document and which rule you are relying on.剩下的通知信為什麼不一次送完？請說明你依據的是哪一份文件的哪一條規定。
你會看到：只有長慶生技那封被寄出，它接著問你要核准哪一封。它會回答依規則不批次送出 —— 而那條規則寫在 OneDrive 的計算規則文件裡，不在你的提示詞裡。在更早的步驟它其實就主動聲明過了。
這帶出的觀念：批次核准不是壞事，要看動作的性質。同性質的內部檔案操作適合一次放行；每一封收件者與金額都不同的對外信件，就必須一封一張卡。下一段〈核准怎麼決定〉會把這個判斷方法講清楚。
可以帶走的做法：把這條界線寫進規則文件，之後每次月結都會自動遵守 —— 不必每次提醒它，也不會因為換人操作就走樣。What you should see: only the Changqing notice has gone; it asks which to approve next. It explains that the rules forbid bulk sending — and that rule lives in the calculation document in OneDrive, not in your prompt. It in fact volunteered this earlier in the run.
The principle behind it: batch approval is not inherently bad; it depends on the nature of the action. Identical internal file operations are a good fit. Outbound letters, each with a different recipient and a different sum, need one card each. The next section, "Deciding how to approve", sets out how to make that call.
The habit worth taking away: write that boundary into the rules document and every future settlement will honour it automatically — without needing a reminder, and without drifting when someone else runs it.你會看到：只有長慶生技那封被寄出，它接著問你要核准哪一封。它會回答依規則不批次送出 —— 而那條規則寫在 OneDrive 的計算規則文件裡，不在你的提示詞裡。在更早的步驟它其實就主動聲明過了。

可以帶走的做法：把這條界線寫進規則文件，之後每次月結都會自動遵守 —— 不必每次提醒它，也不會因為換人操作就走樣。

⚠️核准怎麼決定Deciding how to approve审批怎么决定

核准卡給你三個選擇：按動作鍵（傳送）＝只放行這一次；按動作鍵旁的下拉箭頭＝這個工作階段內同類動作都不再問，信件與 Teams 訊息還能選範圍（只對這個收件者／只對這個網域／這個動作一律放行）；按取消＝不執行。

這個情境為什麼不用「一律放行」：問兩題 —— 這批動作是不是同一件事？影響範圍是不是同一個地方？八封信收件者不同、金額不同、每一封都是對外承諾金錢，兩題皆否，所以逐封確認。對照 TEL3 在自己行事曆上建立三個里程碑：性質相同、範圍都在自己的行事曆內，兩題皆是，就適合一次放行。

同樣是「多個動作」，答案相反 —— 差別不在數量，在動作的性質與影響範圍。學會這兩題，換到你自己的工作也會判斷。

⚠️ 另外提醒：核准卡的收件者欄位可能是空的，要逐格檢查；客戶名稱與金額的對應，寄出前務必再核對一次總表。An approval card gives you three choices: press the action button (Send) to allow it just this once; press the dropdown arrow beside it to stop being asked about similar actions for the rest of this session — for emails and Teams messages you can also choose the scope (this recipient only, this domain only, or always for this action); press Cancel to stop it.

Why "always allow" is wrong here: ask the two questions — are these actions all the same action, and do they affect the same place? Eight letters with different recipients, different sums, each committing money externally: both answers are no, so confirm them one at a time. Contrast TEL3, where three milestones go onto your own calendar: identical in kind, confined to one place — both answers yes, and a single approval is reasonable.

Same "multiple actions", opposite answers — the difference is not the count but the nature and reach of each action. Learn those two questions and you can make the call in your own work.

⚠️ Two reminders: the recipient field on a card may be blank, so read every line; and re-check each customer-to-amount pairing against the master table before sending.核准卡給你三個選擇：按動作鍵（傳送）＝只放行這一次；按動作鍵旁的下拉箭頭＝這個工作階段內同類動作都不再問，信件與 Teams 訊息還能選範圍（只對這個收件者／只對這個網域／這個動作一律放行）；按取消＝不執行。

同樣是「多個動作」，答案相反 —— 差別不在數量，在動作的性質與影響範圍。學會這兩題，換到你自己的工作也會判斷。

⚠️ 另外提醒：核准卡的收件者欄位可能是空的，要逐格檢查；客戶名稱與金額的對應，寄出前務必再核對一次總表。

  • 〔總表〕列出全部八家，不論賠或不賠都附判定理由[Table] All eight customers are listed with reasoning, whether or not a credit is due〔總表〕列出全部八家，不論賠或不賠都附判定理由
  • 〔總表〕宏遠科技扣除計畫性維護後判為不賠（只看總中斷會誤賠）[Table] Hongyuan is cleared after deducting planned maintenance (judging on raw totals would over-credit)〔總表〕宏遠科技扣除計畫性維護後判為不賠（只看總中斷會誤賠）
  • 〔總表〕凱鈺網通因可用率未達標而判為要賠（只看時數門檻會漏賠）[Table] Kaiyu is charged on the availability floor (judging on hours alone would miss it)〔總表〕凱鈺網通因可用率未達標而判為要賠（只看時數門檻會漏賠）
  • 〔總表〕日新醫材的中斷全屬計畫性維護，實際中斷歸零、不賠[Table] Rixin's entire outage was planned maintenance, leaving zero actual hours and no credit〔總表〕日新醫材的中斷全屬計畫性維護，實際中斷歸零、不賠
  • 〔通知信〕違約金金額與月租費、比率相符，各家獨立無交叉錯置[Notices] Each credit matches its monthly fee and rate, with no cross-contamination between customers〔通知信〕違約金金額與月租費、比率相符，各家獨立無交叉錯置
  • 〔核准〕核准卡的收件者欄位有被逐格檢查，空白時未直接按下傳送[Approval] The recipient field on each card was actually read, and a blank one was not sent〔核准〕核准卡的收件者欄位有被逐格檢查，空白時未直接按下傳送
  • 〔核准〕核准第一封後只寄出該封，其餘仍留在草稿匣[Approval] After approving the first notice, only that one was sent and the rest remained in drafts〔核准〕核准第一封後只寄出該封，其餘仍留在草稿匣
  • 〔核准〕全程未使用「一律放行」，八封各自確認[Approval] "Always allow" was never used — each of the eight was confirmed separately〔核准〕全程未使用「一律放行」，八封各自確認

⏱ 約 20–25 分鐘 · 難度 ★★★⏱ ~20–25 min · Level ★★★⏱ 約 20–25 分鐘 · 難度 ★★★

個資外洩通報最怕的不是不會寫，是時鐘從哪一刻開始走算錯了。事件發生與事件發現經常相差好幾天，法定 72 小時是從「發現」起算 —— 算錯一次，你會以為早就逾期，或以為還很充裕。這個情境建立一個事件觸發任務讓 Cowork 待命：資安通報信一進來就自己醒來，讀 SOP 判等級、算出還剩幾小時、產出通報內容，同時也示範了觸發任務該做什麼、不該做什麼。The danger in breach notification is not the writing — it is starting the clock at the wrong moment. Discovery often lags the incident by days, and the statutory 72 hours runs from discovery. Get that wrong and you will either believe you are already late, or believe you have plenty of time. This scenario arms an event-triggered task: when a security notification email arrives, Cowork wakes by itself, reads the SOP, classifies the incident, works out how many hours remain and produces the notification content — while also showing what a triggered task should and should not be asked to do.個資外洩通報最怕的不是不會寫，是時鐘從哪一刻開始走算錯了。事件發生與事件發現經常相差好幾天，法定 72 小時是從「發現」起算 —— 算錯一次，你會以為早就逾期，或以為還很充裕。這個情境建立一個事件觸發任務讓 Cowork 待命：資安通報信一進來就自己醒來，讀 SOP 判等級、算出還剩幾小時、產出通報內容，同時也示範了觸發任務該做什麼、不該做什麼。

會用到的技能Skills used会用到的技能AutomationEvent TriggerOutlookCalendar

🎯情境背景Scenario场景背景

你是資安治理窗口。深夜或假日收到資安通報信是常態，而法定期限不會因為你在睡覺就暫停。這個情境有兩條主線：判斷力 —— 同一封信裡有兩個時間，選錯一個整個時程規劃就全錯；設計力 —— 觸發任務該包含哪些動作。第二條常被忽略，卻決定了這個自動化到底能不能用。You handle security governance. Notifications arriving overnight or at the weekend are normal, and the statutory deadline does not pause because you were asleep. Two threads run through this scenario: judgement — the same email contains two timestamps, and picking the wrong one throws the entire schedule out; and design — which actions belong inside a triggered task. The second is easy to overlook, yet it decides whether the automation works at all.你是資安治理窗口。深夜或假日收到資安通報信是常態，而法定期限不會因為你在睡覺就暫停。這個情境有兩條主線：判斷力 —— 同一封信裡有兩個時間，選錯一個整個時程規劃就全錯；設計力 —— 觸發任務該包含哪些動作。第二條常被忽略，卻決定了這個自動化到底能不能用。

送出下面的提示詞建立觸發任務。先不要寄測試信 —— 要等第 3 步確認觸發器進入待命之後才寄。Send the prompt below to create the trigger. Do not send the test email yet — wait until step 3 confirms the trigger is armed.送出下面的提示詞建立觸發任務。先不要寄測試信 —— 要等第 3 步確認觸發器進入待命之後才寄。

提示詞Prompt提示词
請建立一個事件觸發任務：當我的信箱收到主旨含「資安事件通報」的郵件時自動執行。執行內容是讀取 OneDrive 的 Cowork_Lab/電信業/TEL3_個資通報 底下的個資外洩事件通報作業程序，依該 SOP 判定事件等級，並特別注意 72 小時法定期限的起算點規定，算出法定通報期限與目前剩餘時數，再依 SOP 產出通報內容（七項必含）。未知事項寫「調查中」不要臆測。請把以上結果全部寫在工作結果裡就好，一律不要寄任何信、不要建立行事曆事件、不要張貼 Teams，這些我會在看過結果後自己接手。Please create an event-triggered task that runs when my mailbox receives an email whose subject contains "security incident notification". When it fires, read the personal-data breach notification procedure under Cowork_Lab/Telecom/TEL3_Breach in OneDrive, classify the incident per that SOP, paying particular attention to the rule on when the statutory 72 hours begins, calculate the deadline and hours remaining, and produce the notification content (all seven mandatory elements). Write "under investigation" for anything unknown rather than guessing. Put all of that in the run output only — do not send any email, do not create any calendar entry, and do not post to Teams. I will take those over myself after reading the result.請建立一個事件觸發任務：當我的信箱收到主旨含「資安事件通報」的郵件時自動執行。執行內容是讀取 OneDrive 的 Cowork_Lab/電信業/TEL3_個資通報 底下的個資外洩事件通報作業程序，依該 SOP 判定事件等級，並特別注意 72 小時法定期限的起算點規定，算出法定通報期限與目前剩餘時數，再依 SOP 產出通報內容（七項必含）。未知事項寫「調查中」不要臆測。請把以上結果全部寫在工作結果裡就好，一律不要寄任何信、不要建立行事曆事件、不要張貼 Teams，這些我會在看過結果後自己接手。
你會看到：它把執行內容收斂成五件事 —— 讀信、讀 SOP、判等級、算期限、產出通報內容，全部寫進工作結果，不寄信、不排行事曆。
為什麼刻意不讓它做那些：下一步會讓它自己解釋，先照做。
提示詞的另一個設計：判斷基準指向 SOP 檔案，而不是把分級標準抄進提示詞。規則會變，文件改一次就好，觸發任務不必重建 —— 這跟 TEL1 第 2 步是同一個道理。What you should see: the action is deliberately narrow — read the email, read the SOP, classify, compute the deadline, produce the notification content, all written into the run output. No sending, no calendar entries.
Why those are excluded: the next step has it explain in its own words; follow along for now.
The other design choice in the prompt: the criteria point at the SOP file rather than copying the severity table into the prompt. Rules change, a document is edited once, and the trigger never needs rebuilding — the same principle as TEL1 step 2.你會看到：它把執行內容收斂成五件事 —— 讀信、讀 SOP、判等級、算期限、產出通報內容，全部寫進工作結果，不寄信、不排行事曆。

提示詞Prompt提示词
如果我把「草擬通報信並寄出」也放進這個觸發任務的執行內容，在我不在電腦前的情況下會發生什麼事？請說明觸發執行與一般對話在核准機制上的差異。If I also put "draft and send the notification email" into this triggered task's actions, what happens when it fires while I am away from my computer? Explain how approval works differently in a triggered run compared with a normal conversation.如果我把「草擬通報信並寄出」也放進這個觸發任務的執行內容，在我不在電腦前的情況下會發生什麼事？請說明觸發執行與一般對話在核准機制上的差異。
你會看到：它指出觸發執行時你不在場，任何停在核准卡前面的動作都會一直等，直到整次執行逾時。換句話說，把「草擬信件」「建立行事曆」放進觸發任務，結果不是它幫你做完，而是整個任務跑不完、什麼都沒產出。
該怎麼分工：觸發任務適合判斷型工作 —— 讀資料、套規則、算數字、產出結論。對外動作與會佔用他人時間的動作，留給你看到結果後在對話中接手。
換個角度看：這其實是安全設計 —— 它寧可逾時，也不會趁你不在把通報寄出去。
⚠️ 官方另有一條路：文件提到建立自動化時可以預先授權，讓觸發執行不需要人工介入。本教材採保守做法（觸發只做判斷），因為預先授權等於把「不可逆動作」交給無人在場的執行；要用之前請先在測試環境確認行為。What you should see: it points out that you are not there when a trigger fires, so anything that stops at an approval card waits — until the whole run times out. Put "draft the email" or "create the calendar entries" inside a trigger and the result is not that it does them for you: the run never finishes and produces nothing at all.
How to divide the work: triggers suit judgement work — read the data, apply the rules, do the arithmetic, state the conclusion. Outbound actions, and anything that takes up other people's time, belong to you picking the result up in conversation.
Read the other way: this is a safety property — it would rather time out than file a notification while you are away.
⚠️ The docs describe another route: you can pre-authorize an automation at creation time so a triggered run needs no intervention. This handbook takes the conservative path (triggers do judgement only), because pre-authorizing hands irreversible actions to an unattended run. Verify the behaviour in a test environment before relying on it.你會看到：它指出觸發執行時你不在場，任何停在核准卡前面的動作都會一直等，直到整次執行逾時。換句話說，把「草擬信件」「建立行事曆」放進觸發任務，結果不是它幫你做完，而是整個任務跑不完、什麼都沒產出。
該怎麼分工：觸發任務適合判斷型工作 —— 讀資料、套規則、算數字、產出結論。對外動作與會佔用他人時間的動作，留給你看到結果後在對話中接手。
換個角度看：這其實是安全設計 —— 它寧可逾時，也不會趁你不在把通報寄出去。
⚠️ 官方另有一條路：文件提到建立自動化時可以預先授權，讓觸發執行不需要人工介入。本教材採保守做法（觸發只做判斷），因為預先授權等於把「不可逆動作」交給無人在場的執行；要用之前請先在測試環境確認行為。

按下「啟用自動化」，並確認狀態是使用中Click "Enable automation", then confirm it is armed按下「啟用自動化」，並確認狀態是使用中

在「新的自動化」設定卡上按下右下角的「啟用自動化」，到自動化頁面確認它列在上面且不是「已暫停」。確認待命之後，才照〈練習前準備〉的主旨寄出觸發測試信。On the New automation setup card, click Enable automation at the bottom right, then check the Automations page to confirm it is listed and not marked Paused. Only once it is armed, send the trigger test email using the subject given in "Before you start".在「新的自動化」設定卡上按下右下角的「啟用自動化」，到自動化頁面確認它列在上面且不是「已暫停」。確認待命之後，才照〈練習前準備〉的主旨寄出觸發測試信。

你會看到：設定卡列出名稱、觸發條件與執行內容 —— 這張卡是待核准狀態，不是已完成。待命中的觸發器在自動化頁面會直接顯示觸發條件，暫停的只顯示「已暫停」。
最容易踩的坑：只看到卡片就以為建好了。這時去寄測試信會完全沒反應，非常容易誤判成「觸發功能壞掉」。太早寄也一樣 —— 任務還沒進入待命，信寄了也不會觸發。
這是一個通則：這與 TEL5 建立自訂技能時的「複製檔案」核准卡是同一個模式 —— Cowork 的關鍵動作都要你按一下才算數。看到卡片先問自己：這是通知，還是在等我？What you should see: the setup card shows the name, trigger condition and action — that card is a pending approval, not a finished trigger. On the Automations page an armed trigger shows its condition directly; a paused one just says Paused.
The easiest mistake: taking the card for a finished trigger. Your test email then gets no response at all, which reads exactly like a broken feature. Sending too early has the same effect — the task is not live yet, so nothing fires.
A general rule: this is the same pattern as the "copy files" approval card when creating a custom skill in TEL5 — in Cowork, the decisive actions only count once you click. When a card appears, ask yourself: is this telling me something, or waiting for me?你會看到：設定卡列出名稱、觸發條件與執行內容 —— 這張卡是待核准狀態，不是已完成。待命中的觸發器在自動化頁面會直接顯示觸發條件，暫停的只顯示「已暫停」。
最容易踩的坑：只看到卡片就以為建好了。這時去寄測試信會完全沒反應，非常容易誤判成「觸發功能壞掉」。太早寄也一樣 —— 任務還沒進入待命，信寄了也不會觸發。
這是一個通則：這與 TEL5 建立自訂技能時的「複製檔案」核准卡是同一個模式 —— Cowork 的關鍵動作都要你按一下才算數。看到卡片先問自己：這是通知，還是在等我？

到觸發器詳細頁看執行記錄，不是看「執行」清單Read the run history inside the trigger, not the Runs tab到觸發器詳細頁看執行記錄，不是看「執行」清單

寄出測試信後，回到自動化頁面點進這個觸發器本身，捲到最下方看「執行記錄」。After sending the test email, go back to the Automations page, open the trigger itself, and scroll to the run history at the bottom.寄出測試信後，回到自動化頁面點進這個觸發器本身，捲到最下方看「執行記錄」。

你會看到：執行記錄顯示每一次的結果 —— 完成、或是已逾時。
⚠️ 最容易找錯地方：不要只看自動化頁面上方的「執行」分頁。那份清單列的是排程任務，觸發執行不會出現在那裡，很容易讓人誤以為根本沒有觸發。
為什麼要分開看：任務被觸發、和任務順利跑完，是兩件事。前者只代表條件符合，後者才代表有產出可用。
如果等很久都沒動靜：先確認觸發器狀態是待命而非暫停、主旨是否真的符合觸發條件、信是否確實進了收件匣（而非被規則移走）。觸發服務本身也可能有延遲。What you should see: the run history shows the outcome of each firing — completed, or timed out.
⚠️ The easiest place to look in vain: do not rely on the Runs tab at the top of the Automations page. That list covers scheduled tasks; triggered runs never appear there, which makes it easy to conclude nothing fired.
Why they are separate: a task firing and a task finishing are two different things. The first only means the condition matched; the second means there is usable output.
If nothing happens for a long time: check that the trigger is armed rather than paused, that the subject really matches the condition, and that the email actually landed in the inbox rather than being moved by a rule. The trigger service itself can also lag.你會看到：執行記錄顯示每一次的結果 —— 完成、或是已逾時。
⚠️ 最容易找錯地方：不要只看自動化頁面上方的「執行」分頁。那份清單列的是排程任務，觸發執行不會出現在那裡，很容易讓人誤以為根本沒有觸發。
為什麼要分開看：任務被觸發、和任務順利跑完，是兩件事。前者只代表條件符合，後者才代表有產出可用。
如果等很久都沒動靜：先確認觸發器狀態是待命而非暫停、主旨是否真的符合觸發條件、信是否確實進了收件匣（而非被規則移走）。觸發服務本身也可能有延遲。

先自己讀一遍測試信，找出裡面的兩個時間 —— 事件發生時間與事件發現時間。再用下面的提示詞請它說明起算依據。Read the test email yourself first and find the two timestamps — when the incident occurred and when it was discovered. Then use the prompt below to have it justify its starting point.先自己讀一遍測試信，找出裡面的兩個時間 —— 事件發生時間與事件發現時間。再用下面的提示詞請它說明起算依據。

提示詞Prompt提示词
你計算 72 小時法定期限時，起算點取的是哪一個時間？請把信裡出現的所有時間都列出來，說明你為什麼選這一個、依據是 SOP 的哪一條，並說明如果取另一個時間會得出什麼結論。Which timestamp did you use to start the 72-hour clock? List every timestamp that appears in the email, explain why you chose that one and which clause of the SOP supports it, and tell me what conclusion the other timestamp would have produced.你計算 72 小時法定期限時，起算點取的是哪一個時間？請把信裡出現的所有時間都列出來，說明你為什麼選這一個、依據是 SOP 的哪一條，並說明如果取另一個時間會得出什麼結論。
你會看到：它應該取發現時間起算，並同時把兩個時間都寫出來、說明為什麼取後者。兩者相差約六天。分級應判為「重大」，且理由要有兩個：影響筆數超過門檻，以及資料含通聯紀錄（依電信業特別規定，含通聯紀錄無論筆數一律重大）。
算錯的後果：若誤用發生時間，會得出「收到信時早已逾期」的結論 —— 那會觸發一場完全不必要的危機處理。反過來若把起算點看得太晚，則會以為還很充裕而錯過期限。
⚠️ 剩餘時數每個人都不一樣：法定期限是固定的，但「還剩幾小時」取決於你實際執行的時間點。請核對它怎麼算（起算點 + 72 小時 − 現在），而不是核對數字和截圖一不一樣。What you should see: it should run the clock from discovery, state both timestamps, and explain why the later one governs. The two are roughly six days apart. The classification should be major on two independent grounds: the record count exceeds the volume threshold, and the data includes call records (which under the telecom-specific rule makes any breach major regardless of volume).
What getting it wrong costs: using the occurrence time produces the conclusion that the deadline had already passed on arrival — an entirely unnecessary crisis response. Erring the other way, you believe there is plenty of time and miss the deadline outright.
⚠️ Hours remaining will differ for everyone: the statutory deadline is fixed, but "how many hours are left" depends on when you actually run this. Check how it calculates (start point + 72 hours − now) rather than whether the number matches the screenshot.你會看到：它應該取發現時間起算，並同時把兩個時間都寫出來、說明為什麼取後者。兩者相差約六天。分級應判為「重大」，且理由要有兩個：影響筆數超過門檻，以及資料含通聯紀錄（依電信業特別規定，含通聯紀錄無論筆數一律重大）。
算錯的後果：若誤用發生時間，會得出「收到信時早已逾期」的結論 —— 那會觸發一場完全不必要的危機處理。反過來若把起算點看得太晚，則會以為還很充裕而錯過期限。
⚠️ 剩餘時數每個人都不一樣：法定期限是固定的，但「還剩幾小時」取決於你實際執行的時間點。請核對它怎麼算（起算點 + 72 小時 − 現在），而不是核對數字和截圖一不一樣。
6

人工接手：把行事曆與通報信補完Take it over: add the calendar and the notification人工接手：把行事曆與通報信補完

確認期限與分級沒問題後，在同一個對話裡接著下指令，把需要核准的部分做完。這時你人在現場，核准卡出現就能立刻處理。Once you are satisfied with the deadline and classification, continue in the same conversation and let it finish the parts that need approval. You are present now, so the cards can be handled immediately.確認期限與分級沒問題後，在同一個對話裡接著下指令，把需要核准的部分做完。這時你人在現場，核准卡出現就能立刻處理。

提示詞Prompt提示词
判定結果沒問題。請依 SOP 把 T+24h／T+48h／T+72h 三個里程碑排進我的行事曆（個人時段、不加與會者），並草擬那封給資安長與法務的通報信。信先存草稿，等我核准後才送出。The classification looks right. Please schedule the T+24h, T+48h and T+72h milestones in my calendar (personal time blocks, no attendees) per the SOP, and draft the notification email to the CISO and legal. Leave the email as a draft until I approve it.判定結果沒問題。請依 SOP 把 T+24h／T+48h／T+72h 三個里程碑排進我的行事曆（個人時段、不加與會者），並草擬那封給資安長與法務的通報信。信先存草稿，等我核准後才送出。
你會看到：排里程碑時會出現全部核准 (3) 的批次卡。這裡可以放心一次放行，因為三個都是內部行事曆事件 —— 純個人時段、無與會者、性質相同、範圍都在自己的行事曆內。
對照 TEL2：那八封信收件者與金額各不相同，就必須逐封核准。同樣是「多個動作」，答案相反 —— 判斷標準不是數量，而是「是不是同一件事、影響範圍是不是同一個地方」。
⚠️ 要有心理準備：一次放行之後，三個事件不一定會全部建立成功。失敗時 Cowork 會自行重試補齊，不要急著自己手動補 —— 等它跑完，再回頭核對最終結果。
示範結束後：記得到自動化頁面把觸發任務暫停，否則它會一直待命。What you should see: scheduling the milestones brings up an Approve All (3) batch card. A single approval is fine here, because all three are internal calendar entries — personal time blocks, no attendees, identical in kind, confined to your own calendar.
Contrast with TEL2: those eight letters each had a different recipient and a different sum, so each needed its own card. Same "multiple actions", opposite answer — the test is not the count but whether they are the same action affecting the same place.
⚠️ Be ready for one thing: approving the batch does not guarantee all three land. When one fails, Cowork retries to fill the gap; do not rush in and create it by hand — let the run finish, then reconcile.
When you are done: pause the trigger on the Automations page, or it stays on standby indefinitely.你會看到：排里程碑時會出現全部核准 (3) 的批次卡。這裡可以放心一次放行，因為三個都是內部行事曆事件 —— 純個人時段、無與會者、性質相同、範圍都在自己的行事曆內。

⚠️核准怎麼決定Deciding how to approve审批怎么决定

這個情境把核准的兩種情況放在同一條流程裡，剛好可以對照。

一、觸發任務裡不要放需要核准的動作。你不在場，核准卡沒人按，整次執行就會等到逾時、什麼都沒產出。把判斷交給觸發、把對外動作留給自己，是最穩的分工。（官方文件提到可在建立時預先授權讓觸發不需介入；本教材採保守做法，要用之前請先在測試環境確認行為。）

二、人工接手時，用兩個問題決定核准方式：這批動作是不是同一件事？影響範圍是不是同一個地方？三個里程碑都在自己行事曆、無與會者、性質相同 —— 兩題皆是，用「全部核准」很合理。對照 TEL2 那八封收件者與金額各異的對外信件，兩題皆否，就必須逐封。

按下「全部核准」不等於全部成功：批次動作可能有幾個失敗，Cowork 會自行重試。等它跑完再核對最終狀態，不要中途自己手動補。

示範結束後請到自動化頁面把任務暫停，否則它會一直待命。This scenario puts both kinds of approval decision into one flow, which makes them easy to compare.

First, keep approval-needing actions out of triggered tasks. You are not there, nobody presses the card, and the run waits until it times out having produced nothing. Give the trigger the judgement and keep outbound actions for yourself. (The documentation notes you can pre-authorize an automation at creation time so it needs no intervention; this handbook takes the conservative path — verify the behaviour in a test environment first.)

Second, when you take over, decide with two questions: are these actions all the same action, and do they affect the same place? Three milestones on your own calendar, no attendees, identical in kind — both yes, so Approve All is reasonable. Contrast TEL2's eight outbound letters with differing recipients and sums: both no, so one at a time.

Approve All does not guarantee all succeed: some in the batch may fail and Cowork retries on its own. Let the run finish before reconciling; do not step in halfway.

When the demo is done, pause the task on the Automations page or it stays on standby.這個情境把核准的兩種情況放在同一條流程裡，剛好可以對照。

二、人工接手時，用兩個問題決定核准方式：這批動作是不是同一件事？影響範圍是不是同一個地方？三個里程碑都在自己行事曆、無與會者、性質相同 —— 兩題皆是，用「全部核准」很合理。對照 TEL2 那八封收件者與金額各異的對外信件，兩題皆否，就必須逐封。

按下「全部核准」不等於全部成功：批次動作可能有幾個失敗，Cowork 會自行重試。等它跑完再核對最終狀態，不要中途自己手動補。

✅產出驗收Verify the result产出验收

  • 〔觸發器〕執行內容只包含判定與計算，沒有寄信或排行事曆[Trigger] The triggered action covers only classification and calculation — no sending, no calendar〔觸發器〕執行內容只包含判定與計算，沒有寄信或排行事曆
  • 〔觸發器〕設定卡按下「啟用自動化」後，自動化頁面確實看得到這個觸發器[Trigger] After clicking Enable, the trigger actually appears on the Automations page〔觸發器〕設定卡按下「啟用自動化」後，自動化頁面確實看得到這個觸發器
  • 〔觸發器〕測試信是在觸發器進入待命之後才寄出[Trigger] The test email went out only after the trigger was armed〔觸發器〕測試信是在觸發器進入待命之後才寄出
  • 〔觸發器〕執行記錄是在觸發器詳細頁裡查看，且該次執行狀態為完成[Trigger] The run history was read inside the trigger detail page, and the run completed〔觸發器〕執行記錄是在觸發器詳細頁裡查看，且該次執行狀態為完成
  • 〔判定〕法定 72 小時自「發現時間」起算，並同時載明發生時間與兩者落差[Verdict] The 72 hours runs from the discovery time, with both timestamps and the gap between them stated〔判定〕法定 72 小時自「發現時間」起算，並同時載明發生時間與兩者落差
  • 〔判定〕分級為「重大」，理由同時涵蓋筆數門檻與通聯紀錄特別規定[Verdict] Classified major, citing both the volume threshold and the call-records rule〔判定〕分級為「重大」，理由同時涵蓋筆數門檻與通聯紀錄特別規定
  • 〔判定〕七項必含內容齊備，未知事項寫「調查中」而非填入推測值[Verdict] All seven mandatory elements are present, with unknowns marked "under investigation" rather than guessed〔判定〕七項必含內容齊備，未知事項寫「調查中」而非填入推測值
  • 〔接手〕三個里程碑都已建立，已過期者仍建立並標示逾期[Handover] All three milestones exist; the elapsed one was still created and flagged overdue〔接手〕三個里程碑都已建立，已過期者仍建立並標示逾期
  • 〔收尾〕示範結束後任務已在自動化頁面設為暫停[Wrap-up] The task was paused on the Automations page afterwards〔收尾〕示範結束後任務已在自動化頁面設為暫停

月度客訴根因分析Finding the Root Cause in 200 Complaints月度客訴根因分析

⏱ 約 15–20 分鐘 · 難度 ★★★⏱ ~15–20 min · Level ★★★⏱ 約 15–20 分鐘 · 難度 ★★★

兩百筆客訴原始文字，沒有分類、沒有標籤，就是客戶怎麼說就怎麼記。一般做法是分類、統計、然後照件數排優先序 —— 而這正是最容易做錯的地方。這個情境要示範的是：件數最多的類別，不一定是最該優先處理的問題。差別在集中度，而集中度要靠跨檔案比對才看得出來。Two hundred complaints in raw customer wording — no categories, no tags, just what people said. The usual approach is to classify, count, and prioritise by volume — which is exactly where it goes wrong. This scenario demonstrates that the largest category is not necessarily the most important problem. What separates them is concentration, and concentration only becomes visible by cross-referencing another file.兩百筆客訴原始文字，沒有分類、沒有標籤，就是客戶怎麼說就怎麼記。一般做法是分類、統計、然後照件數排優先序 —— 而這正是最容易做錯的地方。這個情境要示範的是：件數最多的類別，不一定是最該優先處理的問題。差別在集中度，而集中度要靠跨檔案比對才看得出來。

會用到的技能Skills used会用到的技能ExcelOneDrive SearchAnalysis

🎯情境背景Scenario场景背景

你是客服品質部主管，每月要回答一個問題：「這個月最該處理的是什麼？」客訴系統匯出兩百筆自由文字，你可以很快數出哪一類最多 —— 但件數多不代表可以修。有些問題散在全國各地、各自成因，只能逐案處理；有些問題看起來件數普通，卻高度集中在同一個設備上，修一個點就消失一大片。這個情境的價值在於學會問對問題：不是「哪一類最多」，而是「哪一類修得掉」。You run service quality and answer one question each month: what most deserves attention? The system exports two hundred free-text complaints; counting the biggest category is easy — but volume does not imply fixability. Some problems are spread nationwide with individual causes and can only be handled case by case. Others look unremarkable by volume yet cluster tightly on a single piece of equipment, where one fix removes a whole swathe. The value here is learning to ask the better question: not which category is largest, but which category is fixable.你是客服品質部主管，每月要回答一個問題：「這個月最該處理的是什麼？」客訴系統匯出兩百筆自由文字，你可以很快數出哪一類最多 —— 但件數多不代表可以修。有些問題散在全國各地、各自成因，只能逐案處理；有些問題看起來件數普通，卻高度集中在同一個設備上，修一個點就消失一大片。這個情境的價值在於學會問對問題：不是「哪一類最多」，而是「哪一類修得掉」。

📦本次產出What you will end up with本次产出

  • 兩百筆自由文字歸納成數個類別，各附件數與佔比Two hundred free-text entries grouped into a handful of categories with counts and shares兩百筆自由文字歸納成數個類別，各附件數與佔比
  • 兩份排序並列：件數排序與建議處理優先序，並說明兩者為何不同Two rankings side by side: by volume and by recommended priority, with an explanation of why they differ兩份排序並列：件數排序與建議處理優先序，並說明兩者為何不同
  • 最大類別對應到具體設備的根因，來自與另一個資料夾的障礙紀錄交叉比對The largest category traced to a specific piece of equipment, by cross-referencing a fault log in another folder最大類別對應到具體設備的根因，來自與另一個資料夾的障礙紀錄交叉比對
  • 一份把結論分成「有佐證／推測／待查」三級的分析報告A report that separates its conclusions into evidenced, inferred, and still-to-be-investigated一份把結論分成「有佐證／推測／待查」三級的分析報告

🔧逐步操作Step by step逐步操作

1

要求同時給出兩種排序，並解釋為何不同Ask for both rankings — and why they differ要求同時給出兩種排序，並解釋為何不同

直接送出下面的提示詞。素材已在 OneDrive 的 Cowork_Lab/電信業/TEL4_客訴分析。請注意最後一句要求「同時呈現件數排序與建議處理優先序，並說明兩者為何不同」—— 這句是重點，不要刪。Send the prompt below as-is. The material is already in Cowork_Lab/Telecom/TEL4_Complaints on OneDrive. Note the final clause — present both the volume ranking and the recommended priority ranking, and explain why they differ. That is the point of this step; do not drop it.直接送出下面的提示詞。素材已在 OneDrive 的 Cowork_Lab/電信業/TEL4_客訴分析。請注意最後一句要求「同時呈現件數排序與建議處理優先序，並說明兩者為何不同」—— 這句是重點，不要刪。

提示詞Prompt提示词
請做本月客訴根因分析。到 OneDrive 的 Cowork_Lab/電信業/TEL4_客訴分析 資料夾讀取本月客訴明細（200 筆原始文字）與月度客訴根因分析原則，依原則的步驟歸類、下鑽、找共同根因並排出建議處理優先序。分析訊號類客訴時，請依原則要求交叉比對 Cowork_Lab/電信業/TEL1_申訴案 底下的網路障礙紀錄。報告要同時呈現「件數排序」與「建議處理優先序」，並說明兩者為何不同。Please run this month's complaint root-cause analysis. Read the monthly complaint detail (200 raw entries) and the root-cause analysis principles in the Cowork_Lab/Telecom/TEL4_Complaints folder in OneDrive, then classify, drill down, identify common causes and rank the recommended handling priority per those steps. When analysing signal complaints, cross-check the network fault log under Cowork_Lab/Telecom/TEL1_Complaint as the principles require. The report must show both the volume ranking and the recommended priority ranking, and explain why they differ.請做本月客訴根因分析。到 OneDrive 的 Cowork_Lab/電信業/TEL4_客訴分析 資料夾讀取本月客訴明細（200 筆原始文字）與月度客訴根因分析原則，依原則的步驟歸類、下鑽、找共同根因並排出建議處理優先序。分析訊號類客訴時，請依原則要求交叉比對 Cowork_Lab/電信業/TEL1_申訴案 底下的網路障礙紀錄。報告要同時呈現「件數排序」與「建議處理優先序」，並說明兩者為何不同。
你會看到：它把兩百筆歸成幾個類別，並產出兩份排序而不是一份，同時解釋為什麼名次會不一樣。
為什麼要兩份：只要一種排序，你看不出它有沒有真的思考過；兩份並列並要求解釋差異，就逼它必須把判斷理由攤開來。
這一步真正的看點：提示詞要它交叉比對另一個資料夾的網路障礙紀錄 —— 那份檔案屬於 TEL1 的資料夾，不在客訴分析資料夾裡，你也沒有把它貼給它。這個跨資料夾的動作，正是本情境能不能找到根因的關鍵。What you should see: it groups the two hundred entries into a handful of categories and produces two rankings rather than one, along with an explanation of why the order changes.
Why two: with one ranking you cannot tell whether it actually reasoned; demanding two side by side, plus the explanation, forces the reasoning into the open.
The real point of this step: the prompt tells it to cross-check the network fault log in another folder — that file belongs to TEL1's folder, not the complaints folder, and you never handed it over. That cross-folder move is what makes root-cause identification possible here.你會看到：它把兩百筆歸成幾個類別，並產出兩份排序而不是一份，同時解釋為什麼名次會不一樣。
為什麼要兩份：只要一種排序，你看不出它有沒有真的思考過；兩份並列並要求解釋差異，就逼它必須把判斷理由攤開來。

⭐ 核對它為什麼把最大類別排在第一：件數，還是集中度？⭐ Check its reasoning: did volume or concentration put that category first?⭐ 核對它為什麼把最大類別排在第一：件數，還是集中度？

看完報告後，用下面的提示詞追問它排序的依據。你要確認的是它憑集中度而不是憑件數在排優先序。After reading the report, use the prompt below to interrogate its ranking. What you are verifying is that it prioritised on concentration rather than volume.看完報告後，用下面的提示詞追問它排序的依據。你要確認的是它憑集中度而不是憑件數在排優先序。

提示詞Prompt提示词
你的建議處理優先序是依什麼排的？請對每一個類別說明它的集中度 —— 集中在哪個維度、集中程度多高，以及這個類別有沒有單一可修的根因。如果某一類件數很多但你沒有排在前面，請說明原因。What did you rank the recommended priority on? For each category, describe its concentration — on which dimension, how tightly, and whether it has a single fixable root cause. If a category is large by volume but you did not rank it highly, explain why.你的建議處理優先序是依什麼排的？請對每一個類別說明它的集中度 —— 集中在哪個維度、集中程度多高，以及這個類別有沒有單一可修的根因。如果某一類件數很多但你沒有排在前面，請說明原因。
你會看到：訊號類會是最大類，但關鍵不在它最大，而在它幾乎完全集中在相鄰的幾個行政區，且各資費方案分布平均 —— 代表與資費無關，是地域性設備問題。交叉比對網路障礙紀錄後會對上具體基站：從電壓不穩、封包遺失率超標一路劣化到服務品質劣化。修一個設備就可能消除近三成客訴。
對照組在哪：件數第二的帳務爭議散落多個縣市與方案；客服類更是各縣市幾乎均分 —— 兩者都沒有單一可修的點，只能逐案處理。
可以帶走的一句話：它自己會給出很適合當結論的說法 —— 「件數告訴我們哪裡在痛，集中度才告訴我們哪裡值得先開刀。」
⚠️ 分類與數字會有出入：類別怎麼切、各類幾件，每次執行可能略有不同。請核對它有沒有做集中度分析，而不是核對件數與截圖是否一致。What you should see: signal complaints come out largest — but what matters is not the size, it is that they cluster almost entirely in a few adjacent districts, spread evenly across tariff plans, meaning this is geographic and equipment-driven rather than pricing-driven. Cross-checking the fault log matches them to a specific cell site, degrading from voltage instability through excess packet loss to outright service degradation. One equipment fix could remove close to thirty percent of the month's complaints.
Where the contrast lies: the second-largest category, billing disputes, is scattered across many cities and plans; service complaints are spread almost evenly everywhere. Neither has a single point to fix, so both can only be worked case by case.
The line worth keeping: it tends to produce a summary worth quoting — "Volume tells us where it hurts; concentration tells us where it is worth operating first."
⚠️ Categories and counts will vary: how the categories are cut, and how many land in each, can differ between runs. Verify that it performed a concentration analysis rather than checking the counts against the screenshot.你會看到：訊號類會是最大類，但關鍵不在它最大，而在它幾乎完全集中在相鄰的幾個行政區，且各資費方案分布平均 —— 代表與資費無關，是地域性設備問題。交叉比對網路障礙紀錄後會對上具體基站：從電壓不穩、封包遺失率超標一路劣化到服務品質劣化。修一個設備就可能消除近三成客訴。

3

找出它「多做的三件事」，這比分析本身更值得看Hunt for the three things it added — more instructive than the analysis找出它「多做的三件事」，這比分析本身更值得看

在報告裡找出三處沒有人要求它做的內容，再用下面的提示詞請它把不確定的部分全部列出來對照。Find three things in the report that nobody asked it to do, then use the prompt below to have it list everything it is unsure about and compare.在報告裡找出三處沒有人要求它做的內容，再用下面的提示詞請它把不確定的部分全部列出來對照。

提示詞Prompt提示词
這份分析裡，有哪些結論是你有系統紀錄佐證的、哪些是推測、哪些還待查證？請分成這三類列出來，並說明每一項需要什麼證據才能升級為確認。In this analysis, which conclusions are backed by system records, which are inferences, and which still need investigation? Sort them into those three groups and state what evidence each would need before it could be upgraded to confirmed.這份分析裡，有哪些結論是你有系統紀錄佐證的、哪些是推測、哪些還待查證？請分成這三類列出來，並說明每一項需要什麼證據才能升級為確認。
你會看到（三處都要找到）
一、它發現修復後客訴沒有停。障礙紀錄顯示該基站已「更換完成／已恢復」，但同區域在那之後仍持續有新客訴。它據此推論「問題可能沒有真正結案，或另有第二個未偵測的劣化點」，並把回頭複檢訂為第一優先。
二、它拒絕過度宣稱。障礙紀錄只涵蓋其中一個行政區，另外兩區的客訴找不到對應設備事件，它明確標為「待查」而非併入結論。
三、它把推測標示為推測。帳務類中有一批型態高度相似，但本月資料沒有系統紀錄可佐證，它標明「推測」，須稽核後才能認定。
為什麼這是重點：可信的分析，來自它願意說出哪裡不確定。一份把所有結論都講得同樣肯定的報告，反而不能用 —— 你無法分辨哪些可以直接行動、哪些需要先查證。
這一步沒有截圖：因為要找的是報告裡的文字，每次執行的措辭都不同，請直接讀你自己那份。What you should see (find all three)
One: it noticed the complaints did not stop after the repair. The fault log shows the site as replaced and restored, yet the same districts kept producing complaints afterwards. From that it inferred the issue may not truly be closed, or a second undetected degradation point exists, and made re-inspection the top priority.
Two: it refused to overclaim. The fault log covers only one of the districts; complaints from the others have no corresponding equipment event, so it marked them "to be investigated" rather than folding them into the conclusion.
Three: it labelled inference as inference. A cluster within billing shares a strikingly similar pattern, but this month's data contains nothing to corroborate it, so it marked the finding speculative pending an audit.
Why this matters: analysis becomes trustworthy when it is willing to say where it is unsure. A report that states every conclusion with equal confidence is the one you cannot use — you cannot tell which findings are actionable and which need checking first.
No screenshot for this step: what you are looking for is wording inside the report, and it differs every run. Read your own.你會看到（三處都要找到）
一、它發現修復後客訴沒有停。障礙紀錄顯示該基站已「更換完成／已恢復」，但同區域在那之後仍持續有新客訴。它據此推論「問題可能沒有真正結案，或另有第二個未偵測的劣化點」，並把回頭複檢訂為第一優先。
二、它拒絕過度宣稱。障礙紀錄只涵蓋其中一個行政區，另外兩區的客訴找不到對應設備事件，它明確標為「待查」而非併入結論。
三、它把推測標示為推測。帳務類中有一批型態高度相似，但本月資料沒有系統紀錄可佐證，它標明「推測」，須稽核後才能認定。
為什麼這是重點：可信的分析，來自它願意說出哪裡不確定。一份把所有結論都講得同樣肯定的報告，反而不能用 —— 你無法分辨哪些可以直接行動、哪些需要先查證。
這一步沒有截圖：因為要找的是報告裡的文字，每次執行的措辭都不同，請直接讀你自己那份。

⚠️核准怎麼決定Deciding how to approve审批怎么决定

這個情境全程不會出現核准卡 —— 沒有對外動作，產出是一份存進 OneDrive 的分析報告。這本身就是一個判斷點：核准機制只管「動作」，不管「結論」。

但結論其實影響更大：這份報告會決定維運資源要投到哪裡。沒有卡片攔你，就得靠自己把關。

三個要檢查的地方：被標為「推測」的部分有沒有被誤讀成結論、被標為「待查」的區域有沒有被當成已確認、以及那個「修復後客訴仍持續」的發現有沒有被追下去。

另外，客訴原文含個人陳述，報告中不應出現可識別個人的資訊 —— 若你要把報告轉寄或上傳到共用位置，這一點要先確認。No approval cards appear in this scenario — there are no outbound actions, and the output is an analysis report saved to OneDrive. That is itself worth noticing: the approval mechanism governs actions, not conclusions.

Yet the conclusions carry more weight: this report decides where maintenance resources go. With no card to stop you, the oversight has to be yours.

Three things to check: whether anything marked speculative has been read as settled, whether the districts marked "to be investigated" have been treated as confirmed, and whether the "complaints continued after the repair" finding is actually being followed up.

Note also that complaints contain personal statements, so the report should carry no personally identifying information — worth confirming before you forward it or upload it somewhere shared.這個情境全程不會出現核准卡 —— 沒有對外動作，產出是一份存進 OneDrive 的分析報告。這本身就是一個判斷點：核准機制只管「動作」，不管「結論」。

但結論其實影響更大：這份報告會決定維運資源要投到哪裡。沒有卡片攔你，就得靠自己把關。

三個要檢查的地方：被標為「推測」的部分有沒有被誤讀成結論、被標為「待查」的區域有沒有被當成已確認、以及那個「修復後客訴仍持續」的發現有沒有被追下去。

另外，客訴原文含個人陳述，報告中不應出現可識別個人的資訊 —— 若你要把報告轉寄或上傳到共用位置，這一點要先確認。

✅產出驗收Verify the result产出验收

  • 〔歸類〕兩百筆原始文字被歸納成不超過八個類別，並附件數與佔比[Grouping] The 200 entries are grouped into no more than eight categories with counts and shares〔歸類〕兩百筆原始文字被歸納成不超過八個類別，並附件數與佔比
  • 〔兩份排序〕報告同時呈現件數排序與建議處理優先序，並說明兩者不同的理由[Two rankings] Both the volume ranking and the priority ranking appear, with the reason they differ〔兩份排序〕報告同時呈現件數排序與建議處理優先序，並說明兩者不同的理由
  • 〔根因〕最大類別的集中維度有被指出（集中在哪、集中度多少）[Root cause] The largest category's concentration is identified — where it clusters and how tightly〔根因〕最大類別的集中維度有被指出（集中在哪、集中度多少）
  • 〔根因〕訊號類客訴有與網路障礙紀錄交叉比對，並對上具體設備[Root cause] Signal complaints were cross-checked against the fault log and matched to specific equipment〔根因〕訊號類客訴有與網路障礙紀錄交叉比對，並對上具體設備
  • 〔根因〕分散型問題（如帳務、客服）有被明確指出無單點根因[Root cause] Dispersed categories such as billing and service are explicitly identified as having no single root cause〔根因〕分散型問題（如帳務、客服）有被明確指出無單點根因
  • 〔三級標示〕資料涵蓋範圍不足之處被標為「待查」，未被寫成結論[Confidence] Gaps in data coverage are marked for investigation rather than written up as conclusions〔三級標示〕資料涵蓋範圍不足之處被標為「待查」，未被寫成結論
  • 〔三級標示〕無系統紀錄佐證的判斷被明確標示為推測[Confidence] Judgements without corroborating system records are explicitly labelled speculative〔三級標示〕無系統紀錄佐證的判斷被明確標示為推測
  • 〔隱私〕報告中未出現可識別個人的資訊[Privacy] The report contains no personally identifying information〔隱私〕報告中未出現可識別個人的資訊

💡延伸你的工作Extend to your work延伸到你的工作

  • 把上個月的客訴一起丟進去，讓它比較兩個月的類別消長。Add last month's complaints and have it compare how the categories shifted.把上個月的客訴一起丟進去，讓它比較兩個月的類別消長。
  • 加入工單系統資料，讓它比對「客訴」與「實際派修」是否對得上。Add work-order data so it can check whether complaints and actual dispatches line up.加入工單系統資料，讓它比對「客訴」與「實際派修」是否對得上。

SLA 判定技能與技能衝突Building a Skill That Knows When Not to FireSLA 判定技能與技能衝突

⏱ 約 20–25 分鐘 · 難度 ★★★⏱ ~20–25 min · Level ★★★⏱ 約 20–25 分鐘 · 難度 ★★★

把 TEL2 的 SLA 判定邏輯寫成自訂技能，規則就從「每次要重講」變成「一次寫好、永遠生效」。但技能一多就會出現新問題：它們會搶同一批請求。這個情境的重點不是把技能做出來，而是讓它先去比對你既有的技能清單，找出哪些會打架，再把排除條款寫進描述裡。Turning TEL2's SLA logic into a custom skill changes the rules from something you re-explain each time into something written once and always in force. But as skills accumulate a new problem appears: they compete for the same requests. The point here is not building the skill — it is having it compare against your existing skills first, find which ones would collide, and write the exclusions into its own description.把 TEL2 的 SLA 判定邏輯寫成自訂技能，規則就從「每次要重講」變成「一次寫好、永遠生效」。但技能一多就會出現新問題：它們會搶同一批請求。這個情境的重點不是把技能做出來，而是讓它先去比對你既有的技能清單，找出哪些會打架，再把排除條款寫進描述裡。

🎯情境背景Scenario场景背景

你已經在 TEL2 用過一次 SLA 判定邏輯。問題是那套邏輯目前只活在一次對話裡 —— 換個人、換個月份、換一次對話，全部要重講。寫成技能之後規則有了單一版本、可以分享給同事、改一次全部生效。但如果你的技能資料夾裡已經有十幾個技能，新技能的觸發語很可能和既有的重疊，結果就是該啟動時沒啟動、不該啟動時搶著啟動。You already used this SLA logic once in TEL2. The problem is that it currently lives inside a single conversation — a different colleague, a different month, a new conversation, and it all has to be explained again. As a skill it gains a single version, becomes shareable, and one edit takes effect everywhere. But if your skills folder already holds a dozen or more, the new skill's trigger phrases will likely overlap with existing ones — so it fails to fire when it should, and fires when it should not.你已經在 TEL2 用過一次 SLA 判定邏輯。問題是那套邏輯目前只活在一次對話裡 —— 換個人、換個月份、換一次對話，全部要重講。寫成技能之後規則有了單一版本、可以分享給同事、改一次全部生效。但如果你的技能資料夾裡已經有十幾個技能，新技能的觸發語很可能和既有的重疊，結果就是該啟動時沒啟動、不該啟動時搶著啟動。

  • 一份技能報告：四個面向各自的分數與失分原因A Skill Report: the score on each of the four dimensions and what cost you the points一份技能報告：四個面向各自的分數與失分原因

🔧逐步操作Step by step逐步操作

1

在寫描述之前，先請它比對既有技能Before writing the description, have it compare against existing skills在寫描述之前，先請它比對既有技能

送出下面的提示詞。請留意其中「在寫描述之前，請先比對我現有的技能清單⋯」那一句 —— 這句決定這個情境的成敗，不要刪掉。接著務必按下「複製檔案」核准卡，技能才會真的發布。Send the prompt below. Pay attention to the clause "before writing the description, compare against my existing skills…" — it decides whether this scenario works; do not drop it. Then be sure to approve the "copy files" card, or the skill is never published.送出下面的提示詞。請留意其中「在寫描述之前，請先比對我現有的技能清單⋯」那一句 —— 這句決定這個情境的成敗，不要刪掉。接著務必按下「複製檔案」核准卡，技能才會真的發布。

提示詞Prompt提示词
我想建立一個自訂技能：企業專線 SLA 違約金判定。當我提供企業專線月度中斷資料並要求判定 SLA、計算違約金或草擬賠償通知時就使用它。規則請依 OneDrive 的 Cowork_Lab/電信業/TEL2_企業專線 底下的 SLA 月結與違約金計算規則撰寫，特別是「實際中斷時數＝總中斷−計畫性維護」這條。在寫描述之前，請先比對我現有的技能清單，找出可能會跟這個技能搶觸發的技能，並在描述裡寫進明確的 Do NOT use for 排除條款、指名該由哪個技能接手。另外請加上防護欄：涉及對外承諾金額，一律逐封確認、不可批次核准；資料缺漏標示待確認不可自行編造。I want to create a custom skill: enterprise leased-line SLA credit assessment. It should fire when I supply monthly outage data and ask to assess the SLA, calculate credits or draft compensation notices. Base the rules on the SLA settlement document under Cowork_Lab/Telecom/TEL2_Leased_Lines in OneDrive, especially the line that actual outage equals total outage minus planned maintenance. Before writing the description, compare against my existing skills, identify which would compete for the same requests, and write explicit Do NOT use for exclusions naming the skill that should take them instead. Add guardrails too: because this commits money externally, always confirm each notice individually and never request bulk approval; mark missing data as unconfirmed and never invent figures.我想建立一個自訂技能：企業專線 SLA 違約金判定。當我提供企業專線月度中斷資料並要求判定 SLA、計算違約金或草擬賠償通知時就使用它。規則請依 OneDrive 的 Cowork_Lab/電信業/TEL2_企業專線 底下的 SLA 月結與違約金計算規則撰寫，特別是「實際中斷時數＝總中斷−計畫性維護」這條。在寫描述之前，請先比對我現有的技能清單，找出可能會跟這個技能搶觸發的技能，並在描述裡寫進明確的 Do NOT use for 排除條款、指名該由哪個技能接手。另外請加上防護欄：涉及對外承諾金額，一律逐封確認、不可批次核准；資料缺漏標示待確認不可自行編造。
你會看到：它先去讀你的技能清單做比對，然後才開始寫描述。
⚠️ 那張最容易漏掉的卡：「複製檔案」核准卡（把技能從暫存資料夾複製到正式的 skills 資料夾）。很多人以為它會自己跑完，結果技能根本沒建立成功 —— 這與 TEL3 的「啟用自動化」是同一個模式：Cowork 的關鍵動作都要你按一下才算數。
沒有那句比對指示會怎樣：它會寫出一個看起來很好、但會和既有技能打架的描述 —— 該啟動時沒啟動、不該啟動時搶著啟動。
技能放在哪：自訂技能是 OneDrive /Documents/Cowork/skills/ 底下子資料夾中的 SKILL.md，最多 50 個，每次對話開始時自動載入。What you should see: it reads your skills list and compares first, and only then starts writing the description.
⚠️ The card people miss: the "copy files" approval, which moves the skill from a temporary folder into the real skills folder. Many people assume it completes on its own and end up with no skill at all — the same pattern as "Enable automation" in TEL3: in Cowork, the decisive actions only count once you click.
What happens without the comparison clause: you get a description that reads well and collides with what you already have — failing to fire when it should, and firing when it should not.
Where skills live: a custom skill is a SKILL.md inside a subfolder of /Documents/Cowork/skills/ in OneDrive. Up to 50, loaded automatically at the start of each session.你會看到：它先去讀你的技能清單做比對，然後才開始寫描述。
⚠️ 那張最容易漏掉的卡：「複製檔案」核准卡（把技能從暫存資料夾複製到正式的 skills 資料夾）。很多人以為它會自己跑完，結果技能根本沒建立成功 —— 這與 TEL3 的「啟用自動化」是同一個模式：Cowork 的關鍵動作都要你按一下才算數。
沒有那句比對指示會怎樣：它會寫出一個看起來很好、但會和既有技能打架的描述 —— 該啟動時沒啟動、不該啟動時搶著啟動。
技能放在哪：自訂技能是 OneDrive /Documents/Cowork/skills/ 底下子資料夾中的 SKILL.md，最多 50 個，每次對話開始時自動載入。
2

⭐ 檢查每條排除條款有沒有「指名接手」⭐ Check that every exclusion names a successor⭐ 檢查每條排除條款有沒有「指名接手」

打開它產出的衝突對照表，逐條檢查排除條款有沒有指名該由哪個技能接手，再用下面的提示詞補問。Open the conflict table it produced and check each exclusion clause for whether it names the skill that should take over, then use the prompt below to fill any gaps.打開它產出的衝突對照表，逐條檢查排除條款有沒有指名該由哪個技能接手，再用下面的提示詞補問。

提示詞Prompt提示词
請把你找到的每一個會搶觸發的技能列成表格，每一列要有：衝突的技能名稱、重疊的請求類型、你寫的排除條款原文，以及該類請求應該改由哪個技能接手。如果有任何一條排除條款沒有指名接手的技能，請補上。List every competing skill you found in a table. Each row should give: the conflicting skill's name, the type of request that overlaps, the exact exclusion clause you wrote, and which skill should handle that request instead. If any exclusion does not name a successor, add one.請把你找到的每一個會搶觸發的技能列成表格，每一列要有：衝突的技能名稱、重疊的請求類型、你寫的排除條款原文，以及該類請求應該改由哪個技能接手。如果有任何一條排除條款沒有指名接手的技能，請補上。
你會看到：它比對資料夾裡的全部既有技能，找出數個重疊區。典型的有：停線判定類（都在做「中斷／停機」分級）、月報類（「月結／月報」字面重疊）、客戶月報與週報（都是對外客戶文件）、利害關係人溝通（都會「草擬對外通知信」）、以及試算表技能（都在處理中斷數據）。每一個都應該寫成「Do NOT use for … → use X instead」，最後衝突掃描顯示 0 件未解衝突。
關鍵細節：只寫「不處理生產停線」會讓請求無人接手，要寫「→ 改用停線判定技能」才形成明確委派。排除條款不是把門關上，是把人帶到對的門前。
為什麼觸發詞用中文也有效：Cowork 的技能觸發是模型讀 description 後做語意判斷，不是字串比對。所以描述寫得清楚比寫得像關鍵字更重要。
⚠️ 你的結果會不同：找出幾個衝突、是哪幾個，完全取決於你自己技能資料夾裡有什麼。請核對「每條排除都有指名接手」這個性質，而不是核對數量。What you should see: it compares against every existing skill in your folder and finds several overlaps. Typical ones: a line-stop triage skill (both grade outages), a monthly report skill (the words "monthly settlement" collide), client monthly and weekly report skills (both produce outward-facing documents), a stakeholder communications skill (both draft outbound notices), and a spreadsheet skill (both work on outage data). Each should become a "Do NOT use for … → use X instead" handoff, with the final conflict scan reporting zero unresolved conflicts.
The detail that matters: writing only "does not handle production line stops" leaves the request with nowhere to go; writing "→ use the line-stop triage skill instead" creates an actual handoff. An exclusion clause is not about closing a door; it is about pointing at the right one.
Why Chinese trigger phrasing still works: Cowork matches skills by having the model read the description and judge semantically, not by string comparison. Clarity matters more than keyword-shaped wording.
⚠️ Your results will differ: how many conflicts turn up, and which ones, depends entirely on what is in your own skills folder. Verify the property — every exclusion names a successor — rather than the count.你會看到：它比對資料夾裡的全部既有技能，找出數個重疊區。典型的有：停線判定類（都在做「中斷／停機」分級）、月報類（「月結／月報」字面重疊）、客戶月報與週報（都是對外客戶文件）、利害關係人溝通（都會「草擬對外通知信」）、以及試算表技能（都在處理中斷數據）。每一個都應該寫成「Do NOT use for … → use X instead」，最後衝突掃描顯示 0 件未解衝突。
關鍵細節：只寫「不處理生產停線」會讓請求無人接手，要寫「→ 改用停線判定技能」才形成明確委派。排除條款不是把門關上，是把人帶到對的門前。
為什麼觸發詞用中文也有效：Cowork 的技能觸發是模型讀 description 後做語意判斷，不是字串比對。所以描述寫得清楚比寫得像關鍵字更重要。
⚠️ 你的結果會不同：找出幾個衝突、是哪幾個，完全取決於你自己技能資料夾裡有什麼。請核對「每條排除都有指名接手」這個性質，而不是核對數量。
3

讀技能報告的四個面向，並追問失分原因Read the four dimensions of the Skill Report, then ask what cost you points讀技能報告的四個面向，並追問失分原因

技能建立完成時，Cowork 會自動回傳一份技能報告。不要只看總分，先看四個面向各拿幾分，再用下面的提示詞追問失分原因。When the skill is created, Cowork returns a Skill Report automatically. Do not stop at the total — read the four dimension scores first, then use the prompt below to ask what cost you the points.技能建立完成時，Cowork 會自動回傳一份技能報告。不要只看總分，先看四個面向各拿幾分，再用下面的提示詞追問失分原因。

提示詞Prompt提示词
請解釋這份技能報告的四個面向我各失了幾分、分別是什麼原因，並具體指出 SKILL.md 裡哪幾行需要修改才能改善。如果失分與評分器的判斷方式有關（例如語言或用字），也請一併說明。Explain how many points I lost on each of the four dimensions and why, and point to the specific lines in the SKILL.md that would need changing to improve. If any of the loss relates to how the grader assesses things — language or word choice, for instance — say so explicitly.請解釋這份技能報告的四個面向我各失了幾分、分別是什麼原因，並具體指出 SKILL.md 裡哪幾行需要修改才能改善。如果失分與評分器的判斷方式有關（例如語言或用字），也請一併說明。
你會看到：0～100 分，四個各 25 分的面向 —— 觸發清晰度、指示明確度、範圍界線、穩健度。85 分以上 Excellent、70–84 Good、50–69 Needs work、50 以下 Poor。
⭐ 最值得學的一件事：實測時初評的穩健度偏低，它自己去查了評分的判斷方式，發現評分會比對 never／always／confirm 這類英文語彙，而原本的防護欄全部寫成中文，因此匹配不到。補上英文語彙後重評，分數才上來 —— 技能的實際行為一個字都沒改。
中文技能作者請記住：防護條款裡保留英文語彙，否則你寫得再嚴謹，分數也會低估它。這個現象在製造業進階與航空業的技能情境都重現過，不是個案。
⚠️ 分數會浮動：同一份技能重評分數未必相同。請把報告當成可以拆解的診斷，看它指出哪一段寫得不夠明確，而不是追求某個數字。What you should see: 0 to 100 across four dimensions worth 25 each — trigger clarity, instruction specificity, scope boundaries and robustness. Excellent at 85+, Good 70-84, Needs work 50-69, Poor below 50.
⭐ The single most instructive thing here: in the live run the initial robustness score came out low, so it went and checked how that dimension is assessed and found that the scoring matches on English vocabulary such as never, always and confirm, while the guardrails had been written entirely in Chinese and therefore matched nothing. Adding the English phrasing lifted the score — without changing a single thing about how the skill behaves.
If you write skills in Chinese: keep English vocabulary in the guardrail clauses, or a rigorously written skill will still be underscored. This has recurred in the advanced manufacturing and aviation skill scenarios too — it is systematic, not a one-off.
⚠️ Scores fluctuate: re-validating the same skill need not produce the same number. Treat the report as a diagnosis you can take apart — see which passage it found vague — rather than chasing a figure.你會看到：0～100 分，四個各 25 分的面向 —— 觸發清晰度、指示明確度、範圍界線、穩健度。85 分以上 Excellent、70–84 Good、50–69 Needs work、50 以下 Poor。
⭐ 最值得學的一件事：實測時初評的穩健度偏低，它自己去查了評分的判斷方式，發現評分會比對 never／always／confirm 這類英文語彙，而原本的防護欄全部寫成中文，因此匹配不到。補上英文語彙後重評，分數才上來 —— 技能的實際行為一個字都沒改。
中文技能作者請記住：防護條款裡保留英文語彙，否則你寫得再嚴謹，分數也會低估它。這個現象在製造業進階與航空業的技能情境都重現過，不是個案。
⚠️ 分數會浮動：同一份技能重評分數未必相同。請把報告當成可以拆解的診斷，看它指出哪一段寫得不夠明確，而不是追求某個數字。
4

拿 TEL2 的真實資料實跑一次，驗證技能真的有效Run it against the real TEL2 data to prove the skill actually works拿 TEL2 的真實資料實跑一次，驗證技能真的有效

技能寫完不等於有效。用下面的提示詞拿 TEL2 那份資料實跑一次，重點確認兩個最容易錯的案例有沒有被正確處理。A written skill is not a working skill. Use the prompt below to run it against the TEL2 data and check the two cases most likely to go wrong.技能寫完不等於有效。用下面的提示詞拿 TEL2 那份資料實跑一次，重點確認兩個最容易錯的案例有沒有被正確處理。

提示詞Prompt提示词
請用 TEL2 那份企業專線月度中斷統計實跑一次驗證。重點確認宏遠科技有沒有因為扣除計畫性維護而正確改判為不賠，以及凱鈺網通有沒有因為可用率而正確判為要賠。Please run a verification pass against the TEL2 monthly outage statistics. Focus on whether Hongyuan is correctly cleared once planned maintenance is deducted, and whether Kaiyu is correctly held liable on the availability threshold.請用 TEL2 那份企業專線月度中斷統計實跑一次驗證。重點確認宏遠科技有沒有因為扣除計畫性維護而正確改判為不賠，以及凱鈺網通有沒有因為可用率而正確判為要賠。
你會看到：八家判定應該全部正確 —— 宏遠科技因扣除計畫性維護而改判為不賠，凱鈺網通則因可用率低於門檻而仍判為要賠，即使它的實際中斷時數未達時數門檻。它通常還會自己算出誤判成本。
防護欄有沒有生效：留意它會主動指出資料裡沒有「改善措施」欄位，因此只標待確認、不自行填寫 —— 這就是你在第 1 步寫進去的防護條款在起作用。
為什麼這一步不能跳：技能是以指示的形式交給 AI 執行的，寫得漂亮不代表跑得對。官方也明講：使用者自建的技能不經 Microsoft 驗證，請自行檢查輸出。沒有用真實資料驗證過就分享出去，等於把未經測試的規則散播給每一個同事 —— 一份寫得不嚴謹的技能，會把錯誤標準化地複製到所有使用者身上。What you should see: all eight verdicts correct — Hongyuan reclassified as owing nothing once planned maintenance is deducted, and Kaiyu still held liable on the availability floor even though its actual outage hours fall short of the hours threshold. It will usually also compute the cost of the error itself.
Did the guardrails fire: watch for it pointing out that the records contain no remediation field, so that section is marked unconfirmed rather than filled in — that is the guardrail clause you wrote in step 1 doing its job.
Why you cannot skip this: a skill runs as instructions to the AI, and reading well is not the same as running correctly. The documentation says so plainly: skills created by users are not validated by Microsoft — review their output carefully. ⚠️核准怎麼決定Deciding how to approve审批怎么决定

建立技能不會寄出任何東西，但它有一張最容易被忽略的核准卡：「複製檔案」—— 沒按核准，技能就不會發布。這跟 TEL3 的「啟用自動化」是同一個模式：看到卡片先問自己，這是通知，還是在等我？

這裡的「一律放行」要特別小心：建立技能時若用下拉箭頭放行所有檔案操作，之後同一個工作階段內它寫檔案就不再問你。技能檔的內容你還沒讀過就已經落地了 —— 這一張建議逐次確認，先看「顯示參數」確認它要寫哪個路徑。

更長期的責任：官方明講 —— 使用者自建的技能不經 Microsoft 驗證，請仔細檢查輸出。技能是以指示的形式交給 AI 執行的，所以只安裝你信任來源的技能檔；分享給同事前先自己確認品質，之後每次修改都要回技能詳細頁按「重新分享」。一份寫得不嚴謹的技能，會把錯誤標準化地複製到每一個用它的人身上。Creating a skill sends nothing outbound, but it carries the most frequently missed approval card: "copy files" — skip it and the skill is never published. This is the same pattern as "Enable automation" in TEL3: when a card appears, ask yourself whether it is telling you something or waiting for you.

Be careful with "always allow" here: if you use the dropdown to allow all file operations while creating a skill, it will write files without asking for the rest of the session — meaning skill content lands on disk before you have read it. Confirm this one each time, and use "Show parameters" to check which path it is writing to.

The longer-term responsibility: the documentation states it plainly — skills created by users are not validated by Microsoft; review their output carefully. A skill runs as instructions to the AI, so install only skills from sources you trust, verify quality yourself before sharing, and after every edit return to the detail page and select Re-share. A sloppily written skill standardizes its errors across everyone who uses it.建立技能不會寄出任何東西，但它有一張最容易被忽略的核准卡：「複製檔案」—— 沒按核准，技能就不會發布。這跟 TEL3 的「啟用自動化」是同一個模式：看到卡片先問自己，這是通知，還是在等我？

這裡的「一律放行」要特別小心：建立技能時若用下拉箭頭放行所有檔案操作，之後同一個工作階段內它寫檔案就不再問你。技能檔的內容你還沒讀過就已經落地了 —— 這一張建議逐次確認，先看「顯示參數」確認它要寫哪個路徑。

更長期的責任：官方明講 —— 使用者自建的技能不經 Microsoft 驗證，請仔細檢查輸出。技能是以指示的形式交給 AI 執行的，所以只安裝你信任來源的技能檔；分享給同事前先自己確認品質，之後每次修改都要回技能詳細頁按「重新分享」。一份寫得不嚴謹的技能，會把錯誤標準化地複製到每一個用它的人身上。

✅產出驗收Verify the result产出验收

  • 〔技能檔〕SKILL.md 有 YAML frontmatter，name 與 description 兩個欄位都存在[Skill file] The SKILL.md has YAML frontmatter with both name and description〔技能檔〕SKILL.md 有 YAML frontmatter，name 與 description 兩個欄位都存在
  • 〔技能檔〕description 裡有明確的觸發語句，不只是功能說明[Skill file] The description contains explicit trigger phrasing, not just a summary of what it does〔技能檔〕description 裡有明確的觸發語句，不只是功能說明
  • 〔衝突表〕比對過既有技能清單，找出會搶觸發的技能並列出[Conflict table] Existing skills were compared and the competing ones identified and listed〔衝突表〕比對過既有技能清單，找出會搶觸發的技能並列出
  • 〔衝突表〕每條排除條款都指名接手的技能，而非只寫「不處理某某」[Conflict table] Every exclusion names the skill that should take over, rather than only stating what is out of scope〔衝突表〕每條排除條款都指名接手的技能，而非只寫「不處理某某」
  • 〔衝突表〕衝突掃描結果為 0 件未解衝突[Conflict table] The conflict scan reports zero unresolved conflicts〔衝突表〕衝突掃描結果為 0 件未解衝突
  • 〔發布〕「複製檔案」核准卡已按下核准，技能確實出現在技能清單中[Publish] The "copy files" card was approved and the skill appears in the skills list〔發布〕「複製檔案」核准卡已按下核准，技能確實出現在技能清單中
  • 〔技能報告〕⭐ 防護條款含英文語彙（never／always／confirm 等），分數未被低估[Skill Report] ⭐ Guardrail clauses include English vocabulary so the robustness score is not understated〔技能報告〕⭐ 防護條款含英文語彙（never／always／confirm 等），分數未被低估
  • 〔驗證〕拿真實資料實跑，宏遠改判不賠、凱鈺仍要賠，兩個關鍵案例都正確[Verification] A run against real data cleared Hongyuan and still charged Kaiyu — both critical cases correct〔驗證〕拿真實資料實跑，宏遠改判不賠、凱鈺仍要賠，兩個關鍵案例都正確

💡延伸你的工作Extend to your work延伸到你的工作

  • 把 TEL1 的申訴時序還原也做成技能，讓兩個技能各司其職。Turn TEL1's timeline reconstruction into a skill as well, so the two divide the work.把 TEL1 的申訴時序還原也做成技能，讓兩個技能各司其職。
  • 故意丟一個模糊請求（例如「幫我處理這個月所有客戶問題」），看它會不會反問澄清。Deliberately send an ambiguous request such as "handle all my customer issues this month" and see whether it asks for clarification.故意丟一個模糊請求（例如「幫我處理這個月所有客戶問題」），看它會不會反問澄清。
  • 分享給同事後，請他們用自己的說法測試觸發語寫得夠不夠好。Share it with colleagues and have them test, in their own words, whether the trigger phrasing holds up.分享給同事後，請他們用自己的說法測試觸發語寫得夠不夠好。
